items.title: 〈SEMICON〉徐國晉：矽光子2027年滲透率破5成 CPO今年下半年量產
items.title_en: <SEMICON> Xu Guojin: Silicon Photonics Market Penetration to Exceed 50% by 2027, CPO to Enter Volume Production in H2 This Year
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)先進封裝技術發展副總經理徐國晉今(31)日出席SEMI論壇表示，矽光子已逐步成為高階光通訊主流技術，預估2027年市場滲透率將突破5成；另一方面，隨著產業驗證持續成熟，CPO也將自今年下半年開始進入量產階段，代表AI資料中心由電走向光的趨勢進一步確立。
徐國晉指出，AI已不再只是軟體問題，而是實際的硬體設計挑戰。隨著AI模型規模快速擴張，網路頻寬與傳輸能力正被推向既有架構的物理極限，現今AI的運算單位也已不再只是單一伺服器，而是整座資料中心，網路則如同資料中心的神經系統，成為AI算力能否有效擴張的關鍵。
從市場需求來看，徐國晉表示，2025年全球光收發模組銷售額較2024年成長約25%，2026年預期將再成長約50%；其中，高階高速光通訊產品成長更為強勁，2025年相關市場再成長約60%，主要動能幾乎完全來自AI Scale-up需求。
他進一步預期，隨著AI Scale-up持續發展，2028年前後將迎來下一波更大規模的成長週期，也將同步推升高速光互連需求。光纖與光互連正逐漸從過去的傳輸方案，轉變為AI資料中心不可或缺的長期基礎設施。
在此趨勢下，Silicon Photonics (矽光子)重要性快速提升。徐國晉指出，矽光子已成為高階光通訊的重要技術平台，預估至2027年市場滲透率將超過50%，且隨產品規格持續升級，矽光子晶片本身在整體光通訊系統中的價值也將持續增加。
徐國晉也指出，台灣既有的晶圓代工生態系已具備大規模、高量產製造Optical Engine(光引擎)的能力，而當矽光子晶圓製造進一步成熟後，產業下一階段將從Pluggable Optics逐步朝Packaged Optics發展，並進一步邁向CPO。
他表示，產業過去數年持續驗證CPO的可行性，過去市場對成本、可靠度、維修以及光源整合等問題仍有不少疑慮，但目前這些障礙正逐步透過實際數據與市場驗證被突破，顯示CPO已從概念與技術驗證階段，正式朝商業化與量產前進。
徐國晉進一步指出，近期已有大型半導體業者宣布，相關CPO產品將於今年下半年進入量產，代表半導體產業對下一代光互連架構的投入正全面加速，也意味CPO產業發展正式從「能不能做」轉向「如何大規模量產」。
不過，徐國晉強調，CPO並不是單靠晶圓代工或單一光學元件就能完成的技術。除了Silicon Photonics與Optical Engine外，整體供應鏈還涵蓋雷射光源、光纖、光纖連接器、光偵測器、封裝、耦光與測試等多個環節，因此下一階段產業競爭重點將從單一晶片技術，轉向完整生態系的整合能力。
這也是台灣矽光子產業聯盟成立的重要目的。徐國晉表示，台灣真正的優勢不只是晶圓製造或特定光學元件，而是擁有全球少見的完整整合能力，聯盟將扮演設計與製造、本地供應鏈與全球大型業者，以及電子運算與光學技術之間的橋樑。
徐國晉認為，現階段矽光子供應鏈面臨的瓶頸，同時也是台灣產業的新機會。若能進一步串聯晶圓代工、矽光子、雷射、光纖、連接器、封裝與測試等環節，台灣有機會在AI資料中心由電走向光的架構轉型中，掌握更高的系統整合價值，並成為全球AI光互連供應鏈的重要樞紐。
paras_en: TSMC (2330-TW) (TSM-US) Advanced Packaging Technology Development Vice President Xu Guojin attended the SEMI Forum today (31st) and said that silicon photonics is gradually becoming the mainstream technology for high‑end optical communications, with market penetration expected to break 50% by 2027; meanwhile, as industry validation continues to mature, CPO will also move into volume production starting in the second half of this year, further cementing the trend of AI data centers shifting from electrical to optical transmission.

Xu noted that AI is no longer just a software issue but a concrete hardware design challenge. As AI model sizes expand rapidly, network bandwidth and transmission capacity are being pushed to the physical limits of existing architectures. Today’s AI compute units are no longer a single server but an entire data center, with the network acting as the data center’s nervous system and becoming the key to effective AI compute scaling.

Regarding market demand, Xu said global optical transceiver module sales are expected to grow about 25% in 2025 versus 2024, and about 50% again in 2026; high‑end, high‑speed optical communication products will grow even faster, with the related market expanding roughly 60% in 2025, driven almost entirely by AI scale‑up demand.

He further projected that as AI scale‑up continues, around 2028 the next wave of larger‑scale growth cycles will arrive, simultaneously boosting demand for high‑speed optical interconnects. Fiber and optical interconnects are gradually shifting from mere transmission solutions to indispensable long‑term infrastructure for AI data centers.

In this trend, the importance of Silicon Photonics is rising rapidly. Xu pointed out that silicon photonics has become a key technology platform for high‑end optical communications, with market penetration expected to exceed 50% by 2027, and as product specifications keep advancing, the value of silicon photonic chips within overall optical communication systems will continue to rise.

Xu also said Taiwan’s existing wafer‑foundry ecosystem already has the capability to mass‑produce large‑scale Optical Engines, and once silicon photonic wafer manufacturing matures further, the industry’s next stage will evolve from pluggable optics to packaged optics, and then onward to CPO.

He stated that the industry has been validating CPO feasibility for several years; previously the market had many concerns about cost, reliability, maintenance, and light‑source integration, but these obstacles are now being gradually overcome through real data and market validation, showing that CPO has moved from concept and technology verification to commercialisation and volume production.

Xu added that recently major semiconductor companies have announced that related CPO products will enter volume production in the second half of this year, indicating that the semiconductor industry’s investment in next‑generation optical interconnect architectures is accelerating across the board, and that CPO development is shifting from “can we do it?” to “how to mass‑produce it.”

However, Xu emphasized that CPO cannot be achieved by wafer foundries or a single optical component alone. Beyond silicon photonics and Optical Engines, the supply chain also includes laser sources, fibers, fiber connectors, photodetectors, packaging, coupling and testing, so the next competitive focus will shift from single‑chip technology to the ability to integrate a complete ecosystem.

This is also the key purpose of establishing the Taiwan Silicon Photonics Industry Alliance. Xu said Taiwan’s real advantage lies not only in wafer manufacturing or specific optical components but in possessing a globally rare, fully integrated capability; the alliance will act as a bridge among design and manufacturing, local supply chains and global large‑scale players, and between electronic computing and optical technologies.

Xu believes that the current bottlenecks in the silicon photonics supply chain also represent new opportunities for Taiwan’s industry. By further linking wafer foundries, silicon photonics, lasers, fibers, connectors, packaging and testing, Taiwan can capture higher system‑integration value in the transition of AI data centers from electrical to optical architectures and become a pivotal hub in the global AI optical interconnect supply chain.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉股利樂觀！國泰金放量勁揚逾5% 攀逾2個月新高
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Dividend Optimism! Cathay Financial surges over 5% to a new 2‑month high
paras: 國泰金(2882-TW)上周五(8/28)法人說明會釋出樂觀的股利展望，激勵股價今(31)日開高走高，盤中買盤強勢湧入，一度大漲逾 5%、最高衝上 111 元，不僅一舉刷新逾 2 個月以來新高，也逼近前波高點。市場交投熱絡，午盤前成交量便已突破 2.1 萬張，成為金融股中的領頭羊。
受美國科技股下挫影響，台股今天震盪走低，金融族群成為資金避風港，國泰金領銜大漲半根漲停，台新新光金、凱基金、永豐金、華南金、第一金等金控股同步走堅，股價漲幅介逾 1-4%。
國泰金股價強勢噴發，主要來自紮實的基本面表現與充沛的股利配發底氣。根據上周法說會資料，國泰金上半年稅後純益達 765 億元，若加計透過其他綜合損益按公允價值衡量(FVOCI)之股票處分損益後，對本期保留盈餘影響數高達 1659 億元，一舉超越去年全年並創下歷史新高。國泰金調整後淨值衝上 1 兆 5830 億元、每股淨值順利突破百元大關、達 101.2 元。
國泰金經營團隊指出，目前保留盈餘影響數處於歷史高點，在扣除必要提存的特別盈餘公積後，「可分配盈餘量能已達歷史新高」。隨主管機關監理標準趨於明確，核心子公司國泰人壽明年將現金股利上繳金控的展望相當樂觀正向。
國泰金總經理李長庚更在法說會中直言，對於未來的股利發放「絕對比 2021 年時樂觀許多」，並明確表示，有信心今年度的現金股利表現將會「比過去更好」。
在基本面獲利高成長、每股淨值破百元，以及經營層親自掛保證的「股利優於過去」三重利多加持下，激勵買盤踴躍進場卡位，推升國泰金今日價量齊揚，持續向前波高價區衝鋒。
paras_en: Cathay Financial (2882‑TW) released an optimistic dividend outlook at its corporate briefing last Friday (Aug 28), which lifted the stock higher today (Aug 31). Strong buying pressure pushed the price up more than 5%, peaking at NT$111 – a fresh high not seen in over two months and close to the previous peak. Trading was lively, with volume before the lunch break already exceeding 21,000 lots, making it the leader among financial stocks.

Affected by a pullback in U.S. tech stocks, the Taiwan market slipped today, but the financial sector acted as a safe haven. Cathay Financial led the rally, jumping half a limit‑up, while other banks and insurers such as Taishin, Shin Kong Financial, KGI, Yuanta, Hua Nan, and First Financial also rose solidly, with gains ranging roughly between 1% and 4%.

Cathay Financial’s price surge is driven by solid fundamentals and abundant dividend‑paying capacity. According to the briefing materials, its H1 after‑tax net profit reached NT$76.5 billion. Including gains from stock disposals measured at fair value through other comprehensive income (FVOCI), the impact on retained earnings for the period was as high as NT$165.9 billion, surpassing the entire previous year and setting a historic high. Adjusted net assets rose to NT$1.583 trillion, and net asset value per share broke the NT$100 mark, reaching NT$101.2.

The management team noted that retained earnings are at a historic peak, and after deducting the required special surplus reserve, the amount of distributable earnings has reached a new high. With regulatory standards becoming clearer, the core subsidiary Cathay Life’s outlook for cash dividends paid to the holding company next year is very optimistic.

General Manager Li Chang‑geng said at the briefing that the future dividend outlook is "absolutely much more optimistic than in 2021," and he confidently stated that this year’s cash dividend performance will be "better than before."

With high earnings growth, a per‑share net asset value above NT$100, and the management’s personal guarantee that "dividends will be better than before," buying interest surged, driving Cathay Financial’s price and volume higher today and pushing the stock toward the previous high‑price zone.

items.title: 貝森特警告中國1.2兆美元貿易順差「難以持續」！籲G20聯手逼北京轉向內需
items.title_en: Bessent Warns China’s $1.2 Trillion Trade Surplus Is Unsustainable, Urges G20 to Push Beijing Toward Domestic Demand
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週日（30日）表示，他將敦促G20成員重新檢視與中國的貿易條件，以縮小全球經濟失衡，並促使北京調整經濟結構，降低對出口的依賴、轉向國內消費。
根據《路透》報導，貝森特在G20財長會議召開前接受訪問時表示，儘管美國與中國的直接貿易關係正在「快速改善」，但目前中國商品大量出口至全球市場的情況難以持續。
貝森特說：「全球無法承受一個擁有1.2兆美元貿易順差的中國。中國目前的經濟相當疲弱，他們正試圖透過出口來擺脫困境，需要調整經濟結構。」
貝森特推動各國協調應對中國貿易問題之際，美國正因法律上的挫折而被迫重新調整關稅政策。這些關稅措施大幅降低美國自中國進口的商品，但也導致中國商品大量轉向其他市場，尤其是歐洲與拉丁美洲。
美國已透過高額關稅以及全面禁止部分產品進口（包括汽車）等措施，將許多中國商品擋在美國市場之外。貝森特表示，他去年曾告訴其他工業化經濟體，中國進口商品激增將對它們造成壓力，而「現在他們正面臨一些非常嚴峻的選擇」。
貝森特說：「全球其他國家將不得不重新檢視與中國的貿易條件。」他表示，其他國家必須設法給予中國誘因，促使其降低對出口的依賴，並強化長期疲弱的國內需求。
美國正推動G20發布聯合聲明，呼籲降低貿易與經常帳失衡。
根據美國人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）數據，自美國總統川普2025年重返白宮後實施的關稅措施，已使2026年前6個月美國對中國的貿易逆差較2025年同期縮減三分之一，降至739億美元。
基於進口商試圖趕在預期中的關稅措施生效前提前進貨，2025年同期1月部分中國商品進口曾加速。
儘管部分經濟學家及歐洲領袖主張透過協調行動推動人民幣升值，貝森特則質疑此舉的成效。國際貨幣基金（IMF）評估，人民幣可能被低估最多21%。
貝森特表示，認為重新達成一項新的「廣場協議」（Plaza Accord）就能解決經濟失衡的看法並不恰當。1985年的廣場協議旨在透過協調政策促使各國貨幣兌美元升值。
他認為，這只是一種「迴避處理真正貿易問題的簡單方法」，而真正的問題在於中國過度的工業補貼，以及疲弱的國內需求。

下一次美中峰會

貝森特表示，目前尚不清楚他是否會在川普與中國國家主席習近平預計於9月底在白宮舉行會談前，與中國對口官員、中國國務院副總理何立峰親自會面。
貝森特表示，在峰會舉行前，美中官員將繼續就可能降低非戰略性商品關稅，以及人工智慧（AI）安全防護措施展開對話，避免功能強大的AI模型落入非國家行為者手中。
貝森特說：「我認為，雙方可能各自都有價值約300億美元的非戰略性、非關鍵商品，可以取消關稅。」
此次9月峰會正值美國重新調整川普關稅政策之際。美國最高法院先前推翻依據緊急狀態法實施的廣泛關稅措施，其中包括對中國進口商品課徵20%關稅，因此美國目前正重新建立相關關稅政策。
川普政府7月則在一項反強迫勞動貿易調查下，對中國進口商品加徵12.5%關稅；此外，美方也可能在另一項針對產能過剩的調查下，進一步加徵關稅。
貝森特另表示，他計畫在阿什維爾（Asheville）舉行的G20會議期間，與中國人民銀行行長潘功勝舉行雙邊會談，但拒絕透露相關細節。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Sunday (the 30th) said he would urge G20 members to re‑examine trade terms with China to reduce global economic imbalances and push Beijing to adjust its economic structure, reduce reliance on exports, and shift toward domestic consumption.

According to Reuters, Bessent said in an interview before the G20 finance ministers’ meeting that although U.S.–China direct trade relations are "rapidly improving," the current situation of China exporting large volumes of goods to global markets is unsustainable.

Bessent said, "The world cannot bear a China with a $1.2 trillion trade surplus. China’s economy is currently very weak, and they are trying to escape the crisis through exports; they need to adjust their economic structure."

While Bessent pushes for coordinated responses to China’s trade issues, the U.S. is forced to readjust tariff policy due to legal setbacks. These tariff measures have sharply reduced U.S. imports from China but have also caused Chinese goods to shift to other markets, especially Europe and Latin America.

The U.S. has blocked many Chinese goods from the U.S. market through high tariffs and a comprehensive ban on certain products (including automobiles). Bessent said he told other industrialized economies last year that a surge in Chinese imports would pressure them, and "now they face some very tough choices."

Bessent said, "Other countries worldwide will have to re‑examine trade terms with China." He added that other countries must find ways to give China incentives to reduce export reliance and strengthen long‑term weak domestic demand.
The U.S. is pushing the G20 to issue a joint statement calling for a reduction in trade and current‑account imbalances.

According to U.S. Census Bureau data, since President Trump’s return to the White House in 2025 and the implementation of tariff measures, the U.S. trade deficit with China in the first six months of 2026 has shrunk by one‑third compared with the same period in 2025, down to $73.9 billion.
Because importers tried to stock up before the expected tariff measures took effect, some Chinese goods saw accelerated imports in January of the same period in 2025.

Although some economists and European leaders advocate coordinated action to push the renminbi higher, Bessent questioned its effectiveness. The IMF assessed that the renminbi could be undervalued by up to 21%.
Bessent said that the view that a new "Plaza Accord" could solve the imbalance is inappropriate. The 1985 Plaza Accord aimed to coordinate policies to appreciate currencies against the dollar.
He argued that this is merely a "simple way to avoid dealing with real trade problems," and the real issue lies in China’s excessive industrial subsidies and weak domestic demand.

Next U.S.–China summit
Bessent said it is still unclear whether he will meet with China’s counterpart officials, including Vice Premier He Lifeng, before the meeting between Trump and President Xi Jinping scheduled for the end of September at the White House.

Bessent said that before the summit, U.S. and Chinese officials will continue to discuss possible reductions in non‑strategic goods tariffs and AI safety measures to prevent powerful AI models from falling into the hands of non‑state actors.
Bessent said, "I think both sides may each have about $30 billion worth of non‑strategic, non‑critical goods that could have tariffs lifted."

The September summit comes as the U.S. readjusts Trump’s tariff policy. The Supreme Court previously overturned broad tariff measures implemented under the emergency‑status law, including a 20% tariff on Chinese imports, so the U.S. is currently rebuilding related tariff policy.

In July, the Trump administration imposed a 12.5% tariff on Chinese imports under a forced‑labour trade investigation; additionally, the U.S. may impose further tariffs under another investigation targeting overcapacity.
Bessent also said he plans to hold a bilateral meeting with Bank of China Governor Pan Gongsheng during the G20 meeting in Asheville, but declined to disclose details.

items.title: 看多美債40年也變心 「債市多頭總司令」大砍長債轉抱現金
items.title_en: Bullish on 40‑Year U.S. Treasuries Turns to Bearish: The 'Chief Bull of the Bond Market' Cuts Long Bonds for Cash
paras: 有「華爾街債市多頭總司令」之稱的萊西．亨特（Lacy Hunt），在連續看多美債40年後，近期開始轉為看空長期美債。這項轉變不只停留在言論層面，他任職的Hoisington Investment Management已將客戶投資組合的債券有效存續期，從2025年9月約21年大幅降至2026年6月的不到1年，幾乎把所有長期債券部位轉為現金。
亨特認為，1990年至2020年間支撐全球債券多頭行情的「全球化通縮紅利」已出現結構性逆轉。去全球化、人口結構改變、資本日益稀缺，以及超大規模財政赤字等因素疊加，可能使美國長期通膨中樞從過去的1.5%至3.5%，上移至3.5%至4.5%，甚至不排除單季突破5%。
身為債市最具影響力的傳統多頭之一，亨特的轉向被視為核心投資邏輯遭到顛覆，也意味全球經濟可能已進入與過去40年截然不同的長期利率及通膨環境。
全球化紅利逐步消退
亨特指出，過去30年全球通膨受到壓抑，關鍵在於全球化帶來的生產要素重新配置。大量低成本勞動力進入全球供應體系，跨國企業將生產外包至成本較低的國家，持續壓低已開發國家的消費品價格。
如今，全球貿易模式正從「成本優先」轉向「安全與韌性優先」。後疫情時代的供應鏈重建、中美地緣政治競爭、關稅壁壘，以及產業回流與友岸外包政策，使生產、物流和庫存管理成本出現結構性上升。
即使2025年全球商品貿易占全球GDP比重升至68.5%，創1979年以來新高，跨境生產分工仍逐漸被區域內的短供應鏈取代。
缺工與資本稀缺推升成本
人口結構逆轉同樣加劇通膨壓力。美國勞動年齡人口增速放緩、嬰兒潮世代陸續退休，加上移民政策收緊，使經濟從勞動力充裕轉為持續缺工。醫療、建築、旅館及教育等難以外包或快速自動化的服務業，薪資上漲更容易轉嫁至終端價格，形成薪資與物價相互推升的循環。
另一方面，過去壓低利率的「全球儲蓄過剩」也逐漸被資本稀缺取代。美國國民淨儲蓄率已從長期平均占國民收入約6.8%，降至歷史低檔，但AI基礎設施、電網現代化、半導體產能在地化及國防製造升級，均需要龐大投資。在儲蓄不足、資金需求旺盛之下，長期實質利率面臨持續上升壓力。
赤字與利息形成惡性循環
亨特並引述史學家尼爾．弗格森的研究指出，當投資人開始擔憂政府債務的可持續性，便會要求更高的風險溢價，推升長期公債殖利率；殖利率上升又會增加政府利息支出、擴大赤字，進一步強化市場的通膨預期。
2024年，美國債務利息支出首次超過軍事支出，2026財年更突破1兆美元，高於國防預算。隨著債務持續增加，市場必須吸收更多新增公債供給，長期殖利率也將承受上行壓力。
Hoisington已把債券投資組合的有效存續期，從20.88年的高點降至不到1年。亨特直言，通膨已成為長期趨勢，而非暫時波動；在新的總體環境下，黃金的保值能力可能優於長期美債。
截至2026年8月，美國10年期公債殖利率已升破4.5%，30年期殖利率則逼近5%，顯示延續40年的低通膨、低利率時代正面臨根本性改變。
paras_en: Lacy Hunt, known as the "Chief Bull of the Wall Street Bond Market," has shifted from a 40‑year bullish stance on U.S. Treasuries to a bearish view on long‑term bonds. This change is not just verbal; his firm, Hoisington Investment Management, has reduced the effective duration of client bond portfolios from about 21 years in September 2025 to less than one year in June 2026, almost converting all long‑term bond positions into cash.

Hunt argues that the "globalization deflationary dividend" that supported a global bond bull market from 1990 to 2020 has undergone a structural reversal. De‑globalization, demographic shifts, increasing capital scarcity, and massive fiscal deficits may push the U.S. long‑term inflation anchor from the past 1.5%–3.5% range to 3.5%–4.5%, and even a single‑quarter break above 5% cannot be ruled out.

As one of the most influential traditional bulls in the bond market, Hunt’s reversal is seen as a core investment logic upheaval, implying that the global economy may have entered a long‑term interest rate and inflation environment starkly different from the past 40 years.
The globalization dividend is gradually fading.

Hunt points out that for the past 30 years, global inflation has been suppressed largely due to the reallocation of production factors brought about by globalization. Large amounts of low‑cost labor entered global supply chains, and multinational corporations outsourced production to lower‑cost countries, continuously driving down consumer prices in developed nations.

Today, global trade patterns are shifting from a "cost‑first" to a "safety and resilience‑first" approach. Post‑pandemic supply‑chain reconstruction, U.S.–China geopolitical competition, tariff barriers, and policies promoting reshoring and friend‑shore outsourcing have structurally increased production, logistics, and inventory‑management costs.

Even though global commodity trade as a share of global GDP rises to 68.5% in 2025—its highest level since 1979—cross‑border production division is gradually being replaced by regional short supply chains.
Labor shortages and capital scarcity drive up costs.

The reversal in demographic structure also intensifies inflationary pressure. The U.S. labor‑age population growth slows, the baby‑boomer generation retires, and tightened immigration policy turns the economy from labor‑abundant to persistently labor‑short. In service sectors such as healthcare, construction, hospitality, and education—hard to outsource or automate—wage increases more readily translate into end‑price hikes, creating a wage‑price spiral.

On the other hand, the "global savings glut" that previously suppressed rates is gradually being replaced by capital scarcity. U.S. national net savings has fallen from a long‑term average of about 6.8% of national income to historic lows, while AI infrastructure, grid modernization, semiconductor capacity localization, and defense manufacturing upgrades all require massive investment. With insufficient savings and high capital demand, long‑term real rates face sustained upward pressure.
Deficits and interest create a vicious cycle.

Hunt cites historian Neil Ferguson’s research, noting that when investors worry about government debt sustainability, they demand higher risk premiums, pushing up long‑term Treasury yields; higher yields increase government interest expenses, expand deficits, and further strengthen inflation expectations in the market.

In 2024, U.S. debt interest payments exceeded military spending for the first time, and the 2026 fiscal year is projected to surpass $1 trillion, higher than the defense budget. As debt continues to rise, the market must absorb more new Treasury supply, and long‑term yields will face upward pressure.

Hoisington has reduced the effective duration of its bond portfolio from a peak of 20.88 years to less than one year. Hunt bluntly states that inflation has become a long‑term trend rather than a temporary fluctuation; in the new overall environment, gold’s store‑of‑value ability may outperform long‑term U.S. Treasuries.

By August 2026, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield has risen above 4.5%, and the 30‑year yield is approaching 5%, indicating that the 40‑year era of low inflation and low rates is facing a fundamental change.

items.title: 日元貶破160防線 當局隨時突襲干預、緊盯兩個關鍵價位
items.title_en: Yen Breaks 160 Barrier, Authorities Ready to Intervene at Key Levels
paras: 日元兌美元貶破160防線，凸顯出日元極易受到進一步走貶的衝擊，也大幅提高日本當局再次進場干預、阻貶匯率的風險。
儘管確切干預門檻仍不明朗，但多名策略師周一(31日)警告，可能促使當局出手阻止日元急貶的價位不少，最近的觀察點從161開始，其次是162至163區間。不過，他們仍認為，干預行動頂多只能爭取時間，因為日元已回吐7月底展開史上最大規模干預以來逾半數漲幅。
日元最新一波跌勢，主要受到美元上周五全面走強帶動，市場預期美國利率將維持在更高水準，也進一步印證日元走勢很大程度並非日本所能掌控。
日本7月進場干預後，日元未能升破155，隨後再度承壓。當時美國與日本聯手買進日元，是雙方自1998年以來首度採取協調干預行動。
三井住友日興證券資深利率與外匯策略師丸山倫斗表示：「就關鍵價位而言，首先要觀察161，其次是162.9至163.3區間，這是當局上次進場干預的位置。」不過，他指出，政府在前一次干預時「相當重視出其不意」，意味當局隨時都可能採取行動。
周一東京時間上午11點50分，日元兌美元匯率報159.77，較上周五紐約收盤價約160.09升值約0.2%。
根據日本財務省數據顯示，日本在過去一個月內砸下創紀錄的964億美元來支撐日元，此前日元曾崩跌至40年來的低點。財務大臣片山皐月與美國財政部長貝森特皆已暗示，必要時願意再次採取行動。
日本官員多次表明，評估是否有必要干預的關鍵在於匯率變動的速度與失序程度，而非任何特定的匯價水準。
貝森特也曾表示，他期望日本央行總裁植田和男能在貨幣政策上「做出正確的事」，同時形容近期日元的波動「相當受到控制」。
交換市場定價顯示，日本銀行在9月18日政策會議前升息的機率達90%，市場更已完全反映最晚10月30日前升息的預期。
澳洲國民銀行策略師Rodrigo Catril表示：「我們認為，美元兌日元升破162後，干預風險才會明顯升高。當美元全面走強，加上聯準會釋出鷹派訊號時，日本很難出手干預。」
投機性部位也再度轉向不利日元。避險基金在干預後一度大幅削減看空部位，如今又開始建立日元空單。自2025年7月以來，避險基金整體上一直對日元抱持負面看法。
澳洲聯邦銀行策略師Carol Kong表示：「如果日元快速貶值，我不認為日本當局一定要等到日本銀行開會後才再度干預。不過，由於市場已高度反映9月升息的可能性，當局或許會傾向先觀察貨幣政策能否發揮部分支撐日元的效果。」
市場人士指出，只要日本實質利率仍處於深度負值，單靠干預恐怕難以扭轉日元走勢。
華僑銀行策略師Moh Siong Sim認為，鑑於市場預期的升息幅度有限，日本央行正陷入更大的兩難。看來勢必得祭出鼓勵資金回流等其他政策工具，才能扭轉日元疲弱的頹勢。
paras_en: The yen fell below the 160 barrier against the dollar, highlighting its vulnerability to further depreciation and significantly raising the risk of Japanese authorities stepping in to curb the decline.

Although the exact intervention threshold remains unclear, several strategists warned on Monday (31st) that intervention could be triggered at several levels, starting at 161 and then the 162‑163 range. They still believe intervention would only buy time, as the yen has already reversed more than half of the gains since the largest intervention in history at the end of July.

The latest yen selloff was mainly driven by a comprehensive strengthening of the dollar last Friday, with markets expecting U.S. rates to remain higher, further confirming that the yen’s trajectory is largely beyond Japan’s control.

After Japan intervened in July, the yen failed to break above 155 and was subsequently pressured again. At that time, the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen, marking the first coordinated intervention since 1998.

Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities senior interest‑rate and FX strategist Tomoaki Maruyama said, "The key levels to watch are first 161, then the 162.9‑163.3 range, where the authorities last intervened." He added that the government placed great emphasis on surprise in the previous intervention, implying that action could be taken at any time.
At 11:50 a.m. Tokyo time on Monday, the yen was quoted at 159.77 against the dollar, about 0.2% stronger than the New York close on Friday at 160.09.

According to data from Japan’s Ministry of Finance, Japan spent a record 96.4 billion dollars in the past month to support the yen, after it had fallen to a 40‑year low. Finance Minister Hitoshi Katayama and U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen have both signaled willingness to act again if necessary.
Japanese officials have repeatedly stated that the key to deciding whether to intervene lies in the speed and disorder of the exchange‑rate movement, not any specific rate level.
Yellen also said she expects Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda to "do the right thing" in monetary policy, describing the recent yen volatility as "quite controlled."
Market pricing in the foreign‑exchange market shows a 90% probability of a rate hike at the BoJ policy meeting on September 18, with the market fully pricing in a hike by October 30 at the latest.

Australia’s National Australia Bank strategist Rodrigo Catril said, "We believe the risk of intervention rises significantly once the dollar rises above 162 against the yen. With the dollar strengthening and the Fed issuing hawkish signals, Japan would find it difficult to intervene."

Speculative positions have again turned against the yen. Hedge funds had previously cut short positions after intervention, but are now re‑building yen shorts. Since July 2025, hedge funds have generally maintained a negative view of the yen.

Australia’s Commonwealth Bank strategist Carol Kong said, "If the yen depreciates rapidly, I don’t think Japan will wait until the BoJ meeting to intervene again. However, since the market already reflects the likelihood of a September hike, authorities may prefer to observe whether monetary policy can provide some support for the yen."
Market participants note that as long as Japan’s real rates remain deeply negative, intervention alone is unlikely to reverse the yen’s trend.

China‑based Bank of China strategist Moh Siong Sim believes that given the limited expected rate hikes, the BoJ is in a deeper dilemma. It appears that other policy tools, such as encouraging capital inflows, will be needed to reverse the yen’s weak trajectory.

items.title: 光寶科旗下光林智能攜手交通部、雙北 聚焦智慧交通
items.title_en: Leotek, a subsidiary of Lite-On Technology, partners with the Ministry of Transportation, Taipei and New Taipei to focus on smart transportation
paras: 光寶科(2301-TW)旗下光林智能（LEOTEK）與新加坡希達數位（Cedars Digital）於2026亞太永續博覽會「智慧交通永續論壇」提出，AI的下一階段不只是追求更大的模型與算力，而是如何真正進入交通、能源與城市治理，在複雜的實體環境中持續感知、判斷並回應真實需求。
論壇集結交通部運輸研究所、台北市政府交通局、新北市政府交通局及產業代表，從中央政策、城市治理到AI智慧基礎建設展開對話。其中，光林智能聚焦AI如何透過多模態感知理解真實道路；希達數位則從城市碳管理切入，探討AI如何讓碳數據從年度盤查走向即時感知、預測與決策。
台灣永續能源研究基金會董事長、總統府國家氣候變遷對策委員會顧問簡又新大使表示，永續發展已從倡議走向實際行動，企業關注也從減碳進一步延伸到AI、智慧城市、能源轉型與生物多樣性。台灣具備科技、製造及供應鏈優勢，下一階段更重要的是把這些能力轉化成真正解決城市與氣候問題的方案，並與國際市場建立更深的連結。

光林智能智慧交通AI系統架構師鄒恆安（David Tzou）指出，真實道路環境瞬息萬變，單一感測器都有其限制，因此AI要真正理解交通，關鍵在於整合不同的感知能力。Interlux透過攝影機與雷達的感測融合（Sensor Fusion），由攝影機辨識車輛、行人與道路狀況，雷達感知距離、速度與移動方向，再結合車聯網通訊（V2X）與邊緣人工智慧（Edge AI）即時運算，讓不同資訊相互驗證與補強，使AI從「看見物件」進一步理解完整交通情境。
鄒恆安表示，「AI要學會真實世界，第一步是先進入真實世界。」透過部署在道路端的邊緣人工智慧持續取得真實交通數據，才能進一步建立數位孿生（Digital Twin），進行模擬、分析與模型訓練，再將成果帶回實際道路持續驗證與優化，形成AI不斷學習真實交通環境的循環。
希達數位營運長Salmon Sim則從新加坡城市經驗與國際案例切入。他指出，如果把碳數據視為城市的「生命徵象」，再結合AI分析，城市就能從過去一年一次的被動統計，進一步走向即時判讀與持續微調整，加速低碳轉型。這也代表碳管理正從「事後盤查」走向「即時行動」。Salmon的簡報將碳數據比喻為城市的心跳、血壓與體溫。
Salmon表示，AI的價值不只是協助城市看見排放數據，而是進一步找出排放熱點、判斷優先改善位置，並動態降低排放。他以新加坡智慧交通為例，說明AI如何整合道路與公共運輸資訊，持續優化路線與班次；並延伸至英國電網與丹麥哥本哈根建築能源管理案例，呈現AI如何從交通、能源到建築，逐步進入城市低碳治理。
當道路、建築、交通與能源等實體基礎設施持續產生數據，透過物聯網（IoT）、碳數位孿生（Carbon Digital Twin）與AI分析，城市便能更即時掌握變化、預測風險並調整資源配置。減碳不再只是每年產出一份碳盤查報告，而是轉化為城市每天都能採取的行動，並進一步形成低碳競爭力。
交通部運輸研究所所長黃新薰指出，新科技要真正進入日常交通治理，仍需建立資料、制度、驗證與跨系統整合等基礎，才能從示範走向規模化應用。
台北市政府交通局局長謝銘鴻表示，智慧交通最終仍要回到市民需求，包括提升道路安全、移動效率與公共運輸便利性；新北市政府交通局副局長朱建全則指出，新北橫跨不同城鄉與交通場景，智慧交通系統必須具備彈性與擴充能力，才能真正支援城市治理。
中華智慧運輸協會（ITS Taiwan）理事長曾詩淵則從2029 ITS World Congress Taipei出發，指出未來幾年將是台灣累積智慧交通實證、向國際展現智慧運輸實力的重要階段。論壇最後由台北市立大學前瞻運輸研究中心主任張學孔主持高峰對談，串聯中央、地方與產業觀點。
從感測融合讓AI理解一個真實路口，到AI把碳數據轉化為城市的即時「生命徵象」，AI的競爭正從數位世界走向真實世界。對台灣而言，下一步不只是擁有AI技術，更重要的是能否在真實城市持續驗證、累積數據並解決問題，為2029 ITS World Congress Taipei累積可被世界看見的城市實證。
paras_en: Leotek (LEOTEK), a subsidiary of Lite-On Technology (2301‑TW), and Singapore’s Cedars Digital presented at the 2026 Asia Pacific Sustainability Expo’s “Smart Transportation Sustainability Forum” that the next phase of AI is not merely about larger models and computing power, but about truly entering transportation, energy and urban governance, continuously sensing, judging and responding to real needs in complex physical environments.

The forum gathered representatives from the Ministry of Transportation’s Institute of Transportation Research, Taipei City Government’s Transportation Bureau, New Taipei City Government’s Transportation Bureau, and industry, discussing central policy, urban governance and AI smart infrastructure. Leotek focused on how AI can use multimodal perception to understand real roads, while Cedars Digital approached from urban carbon management, exploring how AI can move carbon data from annual inventories to real‑time sensing, forecasting and decision‑making.

Ambassador Jian Yuxin, chairman of the Taiwan Sustainable Energy Research Foundation and advisor to the Presidential Office’s National Climate Change Action Committee, said sustainable development has moved from advocacy to action. Corporate focus has expanded from carbon reduction to AI, smart cities, energy transition and biodiversity. Taiwan’s strengths in technology, manufacturing and supply chains must be transformed into solutions that address urban and climate challenges and deepen ties with the international market.

Leotek’s smart transportation AI system architect David Tzou said that the real‑world road environment changes rapidly and single sensors have limits, so AI must integrate different sensing capabilities. Interlux uses sensor fusion of cameras and radar: cameras identify vehicles, pedestrians and road conditions; radar senses distance, speed and direction; combined with V2X communication and edge AI for real‑time computation, allowing different information to verify and reinforce each other, enabling AI to move from “seeing objects” to fully understanding traffic context.

Tzou added that “AI must learn the real world, and the first step is to enter the real world.” By deploying edge AI on the road, continuous real‑traffic data can be collected to build a digital twin, conduct simulation, analysis and model training, then bring the results back to the road for ongoing verification and optimization, creating a cycle of AI continuously learning the real traffic environment.

Cedars Digital COO Salmon Sim drew on Singapore’s urban experience and international cases. He said if carbon data is treated as a city’s vital signs, combined with AI analysis, the city can move from passive annual statistics to real‑time interpretation and continuous fine‑tuning, accelerating low‑carbon transition. This marks carbon management’s shift from “post‑mortem inventory” to “real‑time action.” Salmon likened carbon data to a city’s heartbeat, blood pressure and temperature.

Salmon explained that AI’s value is not only to help cities see emission data, but to identify emission hotspots, prioritize improvement locations and dynamically reduce emissions. Using Singapore’s smart transportation as an example, he showed how AI integrates road and public transport information to continuously optimize routes and schedules, and extended this to the UK grid and Denmark’s Copenhagen building energy management, demonstrating AI’s progression from transportation, energy to buildings in city low‑carbon governance.

As roads, buildings, transportation and energy infrastructure continuously generate data, through IoT, carbon digital twins and AI analysis, cities can more promptly grasp changes, forecast risks and adjust resource allocation. Carbon reduction is no longer just an annual inventory report but becomes daily actionable steps that build low‑carbon competitiveness.

The director of the Institute of Transportation Research, Huang Xinxun, said that new technology must establish data, systems, verification and cross‑system integration to move from demonstration to scalable application before it can truly enter everyday traffic governance.

Taipei City Transportation Bureau Director Xie Ming‑hong said that smart transportation ultimately must return to citizen needs, including improving road safety, mobility efficiency and public transport convenience. New Taipei City Transportation Bureau Deputy Director Zhu Jian‑quan noted that New Taipei spans diverse urban and rural contexts, so smart transportation systems must be flexible and scalable to truly support city governance.

Chairman of ITS Taiwan, Zeng Shiyuan, from the 2029 ITS World Congress Taipei, said the next few years will be crucial for Taiwan to accumulate smart transportation evidence and showcase its smart transport capabilities internationally. The forum concluded with a summit dialogue hosted by Professor Zhang Xuekong of Taipei City University’s Center for Advanced Transportation Research, linking central, local and industry perspectives.

From sensor fusion enabling AI to understand a real intersection to AI turning carbon data into a city’s real‑time vital signs, AI’s competition is moving from the digital world to the real world. For Taiwan, the next step is not just possessing AI technology but being able to continuously verify, accumulate data and solve problems in real cities, building evidence that can be seen by the world at the 2029 ITS World Congress Taipei.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉和碩處分景碩1.6萬張處分利益近144億元 股價抗跌有撐
paras: 和碩(4938-TW)上周五(28日)公告處分旗下景碩(3189-TW)1.6萬張，將用於充實營運資金，以景碩周五收盤價899元估算，總金額達143.8億元，雖實際處分利益待交易完成後另行公告，但仍激勵和碩今(31)日無懼大盤走弱，股價相對抗跌。
和碩今天早盤以88元開低，盤中翻紅走揚，最高漲至91.5元，漲幅超過3%，成交量則超過4000張。不過三大法人上周減碼和碩，合計賣超2035張。
根據和碩公告，含此次交易，處分1.6萬張景碩後，華瑋投資持有51,037,104股，累積持有金額待交易完成後另行公告，持股比例為9.69%。再加上華毓投資61,939,567股，比例11.76%，以及華旭投資64,924,007股，比例12.32%，和碩仍持有景碩33.77%股權。
不過景碩今天表現弱勢，早盤以844元開低走低，盤中更一度觸及跌停價810元。

items.title: 美國非投等債ETF擁兩大核心防禦優勢成避風港 今年來規模增近2成
items.title_en: U.S. Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond ETFs Offer Two Core Defensive Advantages, Becoming a Safe Haven with Nearly 20% Growth This Year
paras: 美國與伊朗緊張情勢升溫，市場憂心通膨壓力再起，近期美債殖利率飆升至高點，導致市場對聯準會升息的疑慮再起，衝擊股市尤其科技股大幅震盪，資金轉向優質化的美國非投等債ETF避險，根據統計，至今年7月底，國內投信發行的美國非投等債ETF規模已攀升至870億以上，創下歷史新高，更難得的是，美國非投等債ETF規模今年來呈現月月創新高的榮景，今年1至7月總規模已激增近2成。
台新美國非投等債 (00989B-TW)經理人簡大為表示，美國7月通膨降溫，且財政部已迅速啟動大幅回購長天期債券的計劃，引導長債殖利率走跌，預期美國短期升息機率不高，債市仍有表現空間。建議優先布局美國非投資等級債ETF，因其具「較短的存續期間」與「較高的票息收益」兩大核心防禦優勢，受利率波動影響有限，價格表現相對穩健，對於想追求存債領息的投資人，可以鎖定此類兼顧成長與防禦的穩定收息組合。

簡大為指出，隨美聯準會降息時程延後，存續期間短的非投等債ETF，能提供較高票息收益，不僅可有效吸收市場價格波動的風險，還能每月為投資人創造實質的債息收益；中長期來看，投資人透過高透明度的債券ETF 工具，布局美國非投資等級債券市場，相較單純投資個債，ETF能有效分散單一企業的個別信用風險，同時還能藉由一籃子債券的配置，同步提升整體投資組合的收益潛力，是存債領息投資人現階段降低市場風險、彈性理財的好工具。

paras_en: Tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated, sparking renewed concerns about inflation. Recent spikes in U.S. Treasury yields have reignited fears of Fed rate hikes, causing sharp volatility in the stock market—especially in technology stocks—and prompting capital to flow into high‑quality U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs as a hedge. By the end of July, the domestic asset‑management industry had issued U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs with a total net asset value exceeding NT$87 billion, a record high. Remarkably, the size of these ETFs has been hitting new monthly highs throughout the year, with total assets from January to July surging by almost 20%.

Taiwan’s Taishin U.S. Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond ETF (00989B‑TW) manager, Jian Da‑wei, noted that U.S. inflation cooled in July and the Treasury swiftly launched a large‑scale repurchase program for long‑term bonds, pulling long‑term yields lower. He expects the probability of short‑term rate hikes to be low, leaving room for the bond market to perform. He recommends prioritizing U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs, which offer "shorter maturities" and "higher coupon yields" as two core defensive advantages. These ETFs are less affected by interest‑rate swings and tend to perform more steadily, making them an attractive, growth‑and‑defense hybrid for income‑seeking investors.

Jian added that with the Fed’s rate‑cut timeline delayed, short‑duration non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs can deliver higher coupon yields, effectively absorbing market price volatility while generating tangible monthly income for investors. Over the medium to long term, investors can use highly transparent bond‑ETF tools to position themselves in the U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond market. Compared with investing in individual bonds, ETFs provide diversification of issuer credit risk and, through a basket of bonds, can simultaneously enhance the overall portfolio’s return potential. For income‑focused investors, this is a useful tool to reduce market risk and maintain financial flexibility at present.
U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs have reached new monthly highs this year.

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉徐國晉：矽光子2027年滲透率破5成 CPO今年下半年量產
items.title_en: <SEMICON> Xu Guojin: Silicon Photonics Market Penetration to Exceed 50% by 2027, CPO to Enter Volume Production in H2 This Year
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)先進封裝技術發展副總經理徐國晉今(31)日出席SEMI論壇表示，矽光子已逐步成為高階光通訊主流技術，預估2027年市場滲透率將突破5成；另一方面，隨著產業驗證持續成熟，CPO也將自今年下半年開始進入量產階段，代表AI資料中心由電走向光的趨勢進一步確立。
徐國晉指出，AI已不再只是軟體問題，而是實際的硬體設計挑戰。隨著AI模型規模快速擴張，網路頻寬與傳輸能力正被推向既有架構的物理極限，現今AI的運算單位也已不再只是單一伺服器，而是整座資料中心，網路則如同資料中心的神經系統，成為AI算力能否有效擴張的關鍵。
從市場需求來看，徐國晉表示，2025年全球光收發模組銷售額較2024年成長約25%，2026年預期將再成長約50%；其中，高階高速光通訊產品成長更為強勁，2025年相關市場再成長約60%，主要動能幾乎完全來自AI Scale-up需求。
他進一步預期，隨著AI Scale-up持續發展，2028年前後將迎來下一波更大規模的成長週期，也將同步推升高速光互連需求。光纖與光互連正逐漸從過去的傳輸方案，轉變為AI資料中心不可或缺的長期基礎設施。
在此趨勢下，Silicon Photonics (矽光子)重要性快速提升。徐國晉指出，矽光子已成為高階光通訊的重要技術平台，預估至2027年市場滲透率將超過50%，且隨產品規格持續升級，矽光子晶片本身在整體光通訊系統中的價值也將持續增加。
徐國晉也指出，台灣既有的晶圓代工生態系已具備大規模、高量產製造Optical Engine(光引擎)的能力，而當矽光子晶圓製造進一步成熟後，產業下一階段將從Pluggable Optics逐步朝Packaged Optics發展，並進一步邁向CPO。
他表示，產業過去數年持續驗證CPO的可行性，過去市場對成本、可靠度、維修以及光源整合等問題仍有不少疑慮，但目前這些障礙正逐步透過實際數據與市場驗證被突破，顯示CPO已從概念與技術驗證階段，正式朝商業化與量產前進。
徐國晉進一步指出，近期已有大型半導體業者宣布，相關CPO產品將於今年下半年進入量產，代表半導體產業對下一代光互連架構的投入正全面加速，也意味CPO產業發展正式從「能不能做」轉向「如何大規模量產」。
不過，徐國晉強調，CPO並不是單靠晶圓代工或單一光學元件就能完成的技術。除了Silicon Photonics與Optical Engine外，整體供應鏈還涵蓋雷射光源、光纖、光纖連接器、光偵測器、封裝、耦光與測試等多個環節，因此下一階段產業競爭重點將從單一晶片技術，轉向完整生態系的整合能力。
這也是台灣矽光子產業聯盟成立的重要目的。徐國晉表示，台灣真正的優勢不只是晶圓製造或特定光學元件，而是擁有全球少見的完整整合能力，聯盟將扮演設計與製造、本地供應鏈與全球大型業者，以及電子運算與光學技術之間的橋樑。
徐國晉認為，現階段矽光子供應鏈面臨的瓶頸，同時也是台灣產業的新機會。若能進一步串聯晶圓代工、矽光子、雷射、光纖、連接器、封裝與測試等環節，台灣有機會在AI資料中心由電走向光的架構轉型中，掌握更高的系統整合價值，並成為全球AI光互連供應鏈的重要樞紐。
paras_en: TSMC (2330-TW) (TSM-US) Advanced Packaging Technology Development Vice President Xu Guojin attended the SEMI Forum today (31st) and said that silicon photonics is gradually becoming the mainstream technology for high‑end optical communications, with market penetration expected to break 50% by 2027; meanwhile, as industry validation continues to mature, CPO will also move into volume production starting in the second half of this year, further cementing the trend of AI data centers shifting from electrical to optical transmission.

Xu noted that AI is no longer just a software issue but a concrete hardware design challenge. As AI model sizes expand rapidly, network bandwidth and transmission capacity are being pushed to the physical limits of existing architectures. Today’s AI compute units are no longer a single server but an entire data center, with the network acting as the data center’s nervous system and becoming the key to effective AI compute scaling.

Regarding market demand, Xu said global optical transceiver module sales are expected to grow about 25% in 2025 versus 2024, and about 50% again in 2026; high‑end, high‑speed optical communication products will grow even faster, with the related market expanding roughly 60% in 2025, driven almost entirely by AI scale‑up demand.

He further projected that as AI scale‑up continues, around 2028 the next wave of larger‑scale growth cycles will arrive, simultaneously boosting demand for high‑speed optical interconnects. Fiber and optical interconnects are gradually shifting from mere transmission solutions to indispensable long‑term infrastructure for AI data centers.

In this trend, the importance of Silicon Photonics is rising rapidly. Xu pointed out that silicon photonics has become a key technology platform for high‑end optical communications, with market penetration expected to exceed 50% by 2027, and as product specifications keep advancing, the value of silicon photonic chips within overall optical communication systems will continue to rise.

Xu also said Taiwan’s existing wafer‑foundry ecosystem already has the capability to mass‑produce large‑scale Optical Engines, and once silicon photonic wafer manufacturing matures further, the industry’s next stage will evolve from pluggable optics to packaged optics, and then onward to CPO.

He stated that the industry has been validating CPO feasibility for several years; previously the market had many concerns about cost, reliability, maintenance, and light‑source integration, but these obstacles are now being gradually overcome through real data and market validation, showing that CPO has moved from concept and technology verification to commercialisation and volume production.

Xu added that recently major semiconductor companies have announced that related CPO products will enter volume production in the second half of this year, indicating that the semiconductor industry’s investment in next‑generation optical interconnect architectures is accelerating across the board, and that CPO development is shifting from “can we do it?” to “how to mass‑produce it.”

However, Xu emphasized that CPO cannot be achieved by wafer foundries or a single optical component alone. Beyond silicon photonics and Optical Engines, the supply chain also includes laser sources, fibers, fiber connectors, photodetectors, packaging, coupling and testing, so the next competitive focus will shift from single‑chip technology to the ability to integrate a complete ecosystem.

This is also the key purpose of establishing the Taiwan Silicon Photonics Industry Alliance. Xu said Taiwan’s real advantage lies not only in wafer manufacturing or specific optical components but in possessing a globally rare, fully integrated capability; the alliance will act as a bridge among design and manufacturing, local supply chains and global large‑scale players, and between electronic computing and optical technologies.

Xu believes that the current bottlenecks in the silicon photonics supply chain also represent new opportunities for Taiwan’s industry. By further linking wafer foundries, silicon photonics, lasers, fibers, connectors, packaging and testing, Taiwan can capture higher system‑integration value in the transition of AI data centers from electrical to optical architectures and become a pivotal hub in the global AI optical interconnect supply chain.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉股利樂觀！國泰金放量勁揚逾5% 攀逾2個月新高
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Dividend Optimism! Cathay Financial surges over 5% to a new 2‑month high
paras: 國泰金(2882-TW)上周五(8/28)法人說明會釋出樂觀的股利展望，激勵股價今(31)日開高走高，盤中買盤強勢湧入，一度大漲逾 5%、最高衝上 111 元，不僅一舉刷新逾 2 個月以來新高，也逼近前波高點。市場交投熱絡，午盤前成交量便已突破 2.1 萬張，成為金融股中的領頭羊。
受美國科技股下挫影響，台股今天震盪走低，金融族群成為資金避風港，國泰金領銜大漲半根漲停，台新新光金、凱基金、永豐金、華南金、第一金等金控股同步走堅，股價漲幅介逾 1-4%。
國泰金股價強勢噴發，主要來自紮實的基本面表現與充沛的股利配發底氣。根據上周法說會資料，國泰金上半年稅後純益達 765 億元，若加計透過其他綜合損益按公允價值衡量(FVOCI)之股票處分損益後，對本期保留盈餘影響數高達 1659 億元，一舉超越去年全年並創下歷史新高。國泰金調整後淨值衝上 1 兆 5830 億元、每股淨值順利突破百元大關、達 101.2 元。
國泰金經營團隊指出，目前保留盈餘影響數處於歷史高點，在扣除必要提存的特別盈餘公積後，「可分配盈餘量能已達歷史新高」。隨主管機關監理標準趨於明確，核心子公司國泰人壽明年將現金股利上繳金控的展望相當樂觀正向。
國泰金總經理李長庚更在法說會中直言，對於未來的股利發放「絕對比 2021 年時樂觀許多」，並明確表示，有信心今年度的現金股利表現將會「比過去更好」。
在基本面獲利高成長、每股淨值破百元，以及經營層親自掛保證的「股利優於過去」三重利多加持下，激勵買盤踴躍進場卡位，推升國泰金今日價量齊揚，持續向前波高價區衝鋒。
paras_en: Cathay Financial (2882‑TW) released an optimistic dividend outlook at its corporate briefing last Friday (Aug 28), which lifted the stock higher today (Aug 31). Strong buying pressure pushed the price up more than 5%, peaking at NT$111 – a fresh high not seen in over two months and close to the previous peak. Trading was lively, with volume before the lunch break already exceeding 21,000 lots, making it the leader among financial stocks.

Affected by a pullback in U.S. tech stocks, the Taiwan market slipped today, but the financial sector acted as a safe haven. Cathay Financial led the rally, jumping half a limit‑up, while other banks and insurers such as Taishin, Shin Kong Financial, KGI, Yuanta, Hua Nan, and First Financial also rose solidly, with gains ranging roughly between 1% and 4%.

Cathay Financial’s price surge is driven by solid fundamentals and abundant dividend‑paying capacity. According to the briefing materials, its H1 after‑tax net profit reached NT$76.5 billion. Including gains from stock disposals measured at fair value through other comprehensive income (FVOCI), the impact on retained earnings for the period was as high as NT$165.9 billion, surpassing the entire previous year and setting a historic high. Adjusted net assets rose to NT$1.583 trillion, and net asset value per share broke the NT$100 mark, reaching NT$101.2.

The management team noted that retained earnings are at a historic peak, and after deducting the required special surplus reserve, the amount of distributable earnings has reached a new high. With regulatory standards becoming clearer, the core subsidiary Cathay Life’s outlook for cash dividends paid to the holding company next year is very optimistic.

General Manager Li Chang‑geng said at the briefing that the future dividend outlook is "absolutely much more optimistic than in 2021," and he confidently stated that this year’s cash dividend performance will be "better than before."

With high earnings growth, a per‑share net asset value above NT$100, and the management’s personal guarantee that "dividends will be better than before," buying interest surged, driving Cathay Financial’s price and volume higher today and pushing the stock toward the previous high‑price zone.

items.title: 光寶科旗下光林智能攜手交通部、雙北 聚焦智慧交通
items.title_en: Leotek, a subsidiary of Lite-On Technology, partners with the Ministry of Transportation, Taipei and New Taipei to focus on smart transportation
paras: 光寶科(2301-TW)旗下光林智能（LEOTEK）與新加坡希達數位（Cedars Digital）於2026亞太永續博覽會「智慧交通永續論壇」提出，AI的下一階段不只是追求更大的模型與算力，而是如何真正進入交通、能源與城市治理，在複雜的實體環境中持續感知、判斷並回應真實需求。
論壇集結交通部運輸研究所、台北市政府交通局、新北市政府交通局及產業代表，從中央政策、城市治理到AI智慧基礎建設展開對話。其中，光林智能聚焦AI如何透過多模態感知理解真實道路；希達數位則從城市碳管理切入，探討AI如何讓碳數據從年度盤查走向即時感知、預測與決策。
台灣永續能源研究基金會董事長、總統府國家氣候變遷對策委員會顧問簡又新大使表示，永續發展已從倡議走向實際行動，企業關注也從減碳進一步延伸到AI、智慧城市、能源轉型與生物多樣性。台灣具備科技、製造及供應鏈優勢，下一階段更重要的是把這些能力轉化成真正解決城市與氣候問題的方案，並與國際市場建立更深的連結。

光林智能智慧交通AI系統架構師鄒恆安（David Tzou）指出，真實道路環境瞬息萬變，單一感測器都有其限制，因此AI要真正理解交通，關鍵在於整合不同的感知能力。Interlux透過攝影機與雷達的感測融合（Sensor Fusion），由攝影機辨識車輛、行人與道路狀況，雷達感知距離、速度與移動方向，再結合車聯網通訊（V2X）與邊緣人工智慧（Edge AI）即時運算，讓不同資訊相互驗證與補強，使AI從「看見物件」進一步理解完整交通情境。
鄒恆安表示，「AI要學會真實世界，第一步是先進入真實世界。」透過部署在道路端的邊緣人工智慧持續取得真實交通數據，才能進一步建立數位孿生（Digital Twin），進行模擬、分析與模型訓練，再將成果帶回實際道路持續驗證與優化，形成AI不斷學習真實交通環境的循環。
希達數位營運長Salmon Sim則從新加坡城市經驗與國際案例切入。他指出，如果把碳數據視為城市的「生命徵象」，再結合AI分析，城市就能從過去一年一次的被動統計，進一步走向即時判讀與持續微調整，加速低碳轉型。這也代表碳管理正從「事後盤查」走向「即時行動」。Salmon的簡報將碳數據比喻為城市的心跳、血壓與體溫。
Salmon表示，AI的價值不只是協助城市看見排放數據，而是進一步找出排放熱點、判斷優先改善位置，並動態降低排放。他以新加坡智慧交通為例，說明AI如何整合道路與公共運輸資訊，持續優化路線與班次；並延伸至英國電網與丹麥哥本哈根建築能源管理案例，呈現AI如何從交通、能源到建築，逐步進入城市低碳治理。
當道路、建築、交通與能源等實體基礎設施持續產生數據，透過物聯網（IoT）、碳數位孿生（Carbon Digital Twin）與AI分析，城市便能更即時掌握變化、預測風險並調整資源配置。減碳不再只是每年產出一份碳盤查報告，而是轉化為城市每天都能採取的行動，並進一步形成低碳競爭力。
交通部運輸研究所所長黃新薰指出，新科技要真正進入日常交通治理，仍需建立資料、制度、驗證與跨系統整合等基礎，才能從示範走向規模化應用。
台北市政府交通局局長謝銘鴻表示，智慧交通最終仍要回到市民需求，包括提升道路安全、移動效率與公共運輸便利性；新北市政府交通局副局長朱建全則指出，新北橫跨不同城鄉與交通場景，智慧交通系統必須具備彈性與擴充能力，才能真正支援城市治理。
中華智慧運輸協會（ITS Taiwan）理事長曾詩淵則從2029 ITS World Congress Taipei出發，指出未來幾年將是台灣累積智慧交通實證、向國際展現智慧運輸實力的重要階段。論壇最後由台北市立大學前瞻運輸研究中心主任張學孔主持高峰對談，串聯中央、地方與產業觀點。
從感測融合讓AI理解一個真實路口，到AI把碳數據轉化為城市的即時「生命徵象」，AI的競爭正從數位世界走向真實世界。對台灣而言，下一步不只是擁有AI技術，更重要的是能否在真實城市持續驗證、累積數據並解決問題，為2029 ITS World Congress Taipei累積可被世界看見的城市實證。
paras_en: Leotek (LEOTEK), a subsidiary of Lite-On Technology (2301‑TW), and Singapore’s Cedars Digital presented at the 2026 Asia Pacific Sustainability Expo’s “Smart Transportation Sustainability Forum” that the next phase of AI is not merely about larger models and computing power, but about truly entering transportation, energy and urban governance, continuously sensing, judging and responding to real needs in complex physical environments.

The forum gathered representatives from the Ministry of Transportation’s Institute of Transportation Research, Taipei City Government’s Transportation Bureau, New Taipei City Government’s Transportation Bureau, and industry, discussing central policy, urban governance and AI smart infrastructure. Leotek focused on how AI can use multimodal perception to understand real roads, while Cedars Digital approached from urban carbon management, exploring how AI can move carbon data from annual inventories to real‑time sensing, forecasting and decision‑making.

Ambassador Jian Yuxin, chairman of the Taiwan Sustainable Energy Research Foundation and advisor to the Presidential Office’s National Climate Change Action Committee, said sustainable development has moved from advocacy to action. Corporate focus has expanded from carbon reduction to AI, smart cities, energy transition and biodiversity. Taiwan’s strengths in technology, manufacturing and supply chains must be transformed into solutions that address urban and climate challenges and deepen ties with the international market.

Leotek’s smart transportation AI system architect David Tzou said that the real‑world road environment changes rapidly and single sensors have limits, so AI must integrate different sensing capabilities. Interlux uses sensor fusion of cameras and radar: cameras identify vehicles, pedestrians and road conditions; radar senses distance, speed and direction; combined with V2X communication and edge AI for real‑time computation, allowing different information to verify and reinforce each other, enabling AI to move from “seeing objects” to fully understanding traffic context.

Tzou added that “AI must learn the real world, and the first step is to enter the real world.” By deploying edge AI on the road, continuous real‑traffic data can be collected to build a digital twin, conduct simulation, analysis and model training, then bring the results back to the road for ongoing verification and optimization, creating a cycle of AI continuously learning the real traffic environment.

Cedars Digital COO Salmon Sim drew on Singapore’s urban experience and international cases. He said if carbon data is treated as a city’s vital signs, combined with AI analysis, the city can move from passive annual statistics to real‑time interpretation and continuous fine‑tuning, accelerating low‑carbon transition. This marks carbon management’s shift from “post‑mortem inventory” to “real‑time action.” Salmon likened carbon data to a city’s heartbeat, blood pressure and temperature.

Salmon explained that AI’s value is not only to help cities see emission data, but to identify emission hotspots, prioritize improvement locations and dynamically reduce emissions. Using Singapore’s smart transportation as an example, he showed how AI integrates road and public transport information to continuously optimize routes and schedules, and extended this to the UK grid and Denmark’s Copenhagen building energy management, demonstrating AI’s progression from transportation, energy to buildings in city low‑carbon governance.

As roads, buildings, transportation and energy infrastructure continuously generate data, through IoT, carbon digital twins and AI analysis, cities can more promptly grasp changes, forecast risks and adjust resource allocation. Carbon reduction is no longer just an annual inventory report but becomes daily actionable steps that build low‑carbon competitiveness.

The director of the Institute of Transportation Research, Huang Xinxun, said that new technology must establish data, systems, verification and cross‑system integration to move from demonstration to scalable application before it can truly enter everyday traffic governance.

Taipei City Transportation Bureau Director Xie Ming‑hong said that smart transportation ultimately must return to citizen needs, including improving road safety, mobility efficiency and public transport convenience. New Taipei City Transportation Bureau Deputy Director Zhu Jian‑quan noted that New Taipei spans diverse urban and rural contexts, so smart transportation systems must be flexible and scalable to truly support city governance.

Chairman of ITS Taiwan, Zeng Shiyuan, from the 2029 ITS World Congress Taipei, said the next few years will be crucial for Taiwan to accumulate smart transportation evidence and showcase its smart transport capabilities internationally. The forum concluded with a summit dialogue hosted by Professor Zhang Xuekong of Taipei City University’s Center for Advanced Transportation Research, linking central, local and industry perspectives.

From sensor fusion enabling AI to understand a real intersection to AI turning carbon data into a city’s real‑time vital signs, AI’s competition is moving from the digital world to the real world. For Taiwan, the next step is not just possessing AI technology but being able to continuously verify, accumulate data and solve problems in real cities, building evidence that can be seen by the world at the 2029 ITS World Congress Taipei.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉和碩處分景碩1.6萬張處分利益近144億元 股價抗跌有撐
paras: 和碩(4938-TW)上周五(28日)公告處分旗下景碩(3189-TW)1.6萬張，將用於充實營運資金，以景碩周五收盤價899元估算，總金額達143.8億元，雖實際處分利益待交易完成後另行公告，但仍激勵和碩今(31)日無懼大盤走弱，股價相對抗跌。
和碩今天早盤以88元開低，盤中翻紅走揚，最高漲至91.5元，漲幅超過3%，成交量則超過4000張。不過三大法人上周減碼和碩，合計賣超2035張。
根據和碩公告，含此次交易，處分1.6萬張景碩後，華瑋投資持有51,037,104股，累積持有金額待交易完成後另行公告，持股比例為9.69%。再加上華毓投資61,939,567股，比例11.76%，以及華旭投資64,924,007股，比例12.32%，和碩仍持有景碩33.77%股權。
不過景碩今天表現弱勢，早盤以844元開低走低，盤中更一度觸及跌停價810元。

items.title: 美國非投等債ETF擁兩大核心防禦優勢成避風港 今年來規模增近2成
items.title_en: U.S. Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond ETFs Offer Two Core Defensive Advantages, Becoming a Safe Haven with Nearly 20% Growth This Year
paras: 美國與伊朗緊張情勢升溫，市場憂心通膨壓力再起，近期美債殖利率飆升至高點，導致市場對聯準會升息的疑慮再起，衝擊股市尤其科技股大幅震盪，資金轉向優質化的美國非投等債ETF避險，根據統計，至今年7月底，國內投信發行的美國非投等債ETF規模已攀升至870億以上，創下歷史新高，更難得的是，美國非投等債ETF規模今年來呈現月月創新高的榮景，今年1至7月總規模已激增近2成。
台新美國非投等債 (00989B-TW)經理人簡大為表示，美國7月通膨降溫，且財政部已迅速啟動大幅回購長天期債券的計劃，引導長債殖利率走跌，預期美國短期升息機率不高，債市仍有表現空間。建議優先布局美國非投資等級債ETF，因其具「較短的存續期間」與「較高的票息收益」兩大核心防禦優勢，受利率波動影響有限，價格表現相對穩健，對於想追求存債領息的投資人，可以鎖定此類兼顧成長與防禦的穩定收息組合。

簡大為指出，隨美聯準會降息時程延後，存續期間短的非投等債ETF，能提供較高票息收益，不僅可有效吸收市場價格波動的風險，還能每月為投資人創造實質的債息收益；中長期來看，投資人透過高透明度的債券ETF 工具，布局美國非投資等級債券市場，相較單純投資個債，ETF能有效分散單一企業的個別信用風險，同時還能藉由一籃子債券的配置，同步提升整體投資組合的收益潛力，是存債領息投資人現階段降低市場風險、彈性理財的好工具。

paras_en: Tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated, sparking renewed concerns about inflation. Recent spikes in U.S. Treasury yields have reignited fears of Fed rate hikes, causing sharp volatility in the stock market—especially in technology stocks—and prompting capital to flow into high‑quality U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs as a hedge. By the end of July, the domestic asset‑management industry had issued U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs with a total net asset value exceeding NT$87 billion, a record high. Remarkably, the size of these ETFs has been hitting new monthly highs throughout the year, with total assets from January to July surging by almost 20%.

Taiwan’s Taishin U.S. Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond ETF (00989B‑TW) manager, Jian Da‑wei, noted that U.S. inflation cooled in July and the Treasury swiftly launched a large‑scale repurchase program for long‑term bonds, pulling long‑term yields lower. He expects the probability of short‑term rate hikes to be low, leaving room for the bond market to perform. He recommends prioritizing U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs, which offer "shorter maturities" and "higher coupon yields" as two core defensive advantages. These ETFs are less affected by interest‑rate swings and tend to perform more steadily, making them an attractive, growth‑and‑defense hybrid for income‑seeking investors.

Jian added that with the Fed’s rate‑cut timeline delayed, short‑duration non‑investment‑grade bond ETFs can deliver higher coupon yields, effectively absorbing market price volatility while generating tangible monthly income for investors. Over the medium to long term, investors can use highly transparent bond‑ETF tools to position themselves in the U.S. non‑investment‑grade bond market. Compared with investing in individual bonds, ETFs provide diversification of issuer credit risk and, through a basket of bonds, can simultaneously enhance the overall portfolio’s return potential. For income‑focused investors, this is a useful tool to reduce market risk and maintain financial flexibility at present.

items.title: 國際廢鋼築底有撐 豐興鋼筋盤價開漲盤
items.title_en: International Scrap Steel Finds Bottom Support, Fengxing Rebar Prices Open Higher
paras: 電爐煉鋼廠豐興(2015-TW)今(31)日表示，國際廢鋼築底有撐、小鋼胚翻漲，加上國內鋼筋上周成交量回升，因此本周廢鋼收購價及鋼筋盤價每公噸上漲200元，也是相隔逾1個多月再度開出漲盤。
國際一周行情來看，美國大船廢鋼及日本2H廢鋼均無報價，美國貨櫃廢鋼則小漲2美元來到每公噸332美元，澳洲鐵礦砂由每公噸97.35美元漲至100美元。
豐興表示，國際廢鋼看跌不跌甚至小漲，小鋼胚更是翻漲，預期後續廢鋼仍有上漲空間，因此公司決定反應市場預期，穩定廢鐵商交貨意願，在成本高掛下，鋼筋也需漲價反應成本，上週鋼筋也有部分較大的成交。
此次盤價調整後，豐興廢鋼收購價來到每公噸9400元、鋼筋每公噸1.78萬元、型鋼基價則維持平盤每公噸2.5萬元。
paras_en: Electric furnace steelmaker Fengxing (2015‑TW) said today (31st) that international scrap steel has found bottom support, small steel billets have rebounded, and domestic rebar trading volume recovered last week, so this week the scrap steel purchase price and rebar floor price rose by NT$200 per ton, marking the first rise in over a month.

Looking at the international weekly market, there were no quotes for large‑ship scrap steel in the United States nor for Japan’s 2H scrap steel; U.S. container scrap steel edged up $2 to $332 per ton, and Australian iron‑ore fines rose from $97.35 to $100 per ton.

Fengxing said that international scrap steel is not falling but even slightly rising, and small billets have turned higher; it expects further upside for scrap steel, so the company decided to reflect market expectations, stabilize scrap‑iron suppliers’ delivery willingness, and with high costs, rebar also needs price increases to reflect costs. Last week, rebar saw some larger transactions.
After this price adjustment, Fengxing’s scrap steel purchase price is NT$9,400 per ton, rebar NT$17,800 per ton, and the base price for structural steel remains flat at NT$25,000 per ton.

items.title: 衛福部9月新政一表看！放寬降血脂藥112萬人受惠 試管嬰兒最高給付15萬
items.title_en: Ministry of Health and Welfare September New Policies: 1.12 Million Benefit from Expanded Lipid‑Lowering Drug Coverage; IVF Subsidy Up to NT$150,000 per Cycle
paras: 衛生福利部今(31)日公布115年9月1日起上路的多項攸關民眾權益之重大政策與措施。其中影響涵蓋面最廣的為健保署擴大降血脂藥物給付規定，預估第1年至第5年新增受益人數高達99.8萬至111.7萬人；此外，口腔健康司放寬兒童免費塗氟年齡上限至「進入國小當年度之8月31日止」，每年預估新增近13萬名兒童受益、服務達117萬人次。此外，試管嬰兒每胎第2、3次療程最高補助加碼至15萬元也自明天生效。
在孕育與婦幼政策方面，國健署同步祭出「擴大加碼試管嬰兒補助」。針對受術妻未滿40歲者，每胎第2、3次療程最高補助金額由現行10萬元提高至15萬元；受術妻40歲至未滿45歲者，則由最高8萬元提升至13萬元。預計每年近2萬人次申請中，有近5,000人次（約四分之一）可獲得更高額度之資金支持，大幅減輕不孕家庭負擔。
針對醫療給付與護理環境，健保署自9月1日起新增「周邊動脈粥樣斑塊旋切術」等20項診療項目，受惠約1萬871人；同時調升兒科、產科、護理費及人力流失科別之支付標準，共計挹注53億元，若包含先前已調整項目，累計挹注已超過百億元，持續強化國內急重症及醫療照護量能。
在罕病與新藥給付部分，健保署暫予支付口服藥物Fabhalta（服易達），用於治療陣發性夜間血紅素尿症（PNH）成人患者，每年約18至28人受惠；另將Livmarli（邁芮倍）納入給付，用於治療進行性家族性肝內膽汁滯留症（PFIC）及阿拉吉歐症候群（ALGS）患者之嚴重搔癢症狀，積極落實照顧罕病患者之承諾。
衛福部115年9月新實施重大政策一覽表
paras_en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare announced today (the 31st) a series of major policies and measures that will take effect on September 1, 2026, affecting citizens’ rights. The most far‑reaching is the National Health Insurance Administration’s expansion of coverage for lipid‑lowering drugs, projected to add between 998,000 and 1,117,000 new beneficiaries over the first five years. In addition, the Oral Health Division will raise the age limit for free fluoride varnish for children to “until August 31 of the year they enter elementary school,” expected to benefit nearly 130,000 additional children each year, serving a total of 1.17 million visits. Also, the maximum subsidy for the second and third IVF cycles will increase to NT$150,000 per pregnancy, effective from tomorrow.

In the realm of reproductive and maternal‑child policies, the National Health Insurance Administration simultaneously rolled out an “expanded IVF subsidy.” For women under 40 undergoing treatment, the maximum subsidy for the second and third cycles rises from the current NT$100,000 to NT$150,000; for women aged 40 to under 45, the cap increases from NT$80,000 to NT$130,000. Of the roughly 20,000 annual applicants, about 5,000 (around one‑quarter) are expected to receive the higher funding, substantially easing the financial burden on infertile families.

Regarding medical reimbursements and care environments, the National Health Insurance Administration will, starting September 1, add 20 new service items such as “peripheral arterial atherosclerotic plaque atherectomy,” benefiting approximately 18,710 patients. At the same time, payment standards for pediatrics, obstetrics, nursing services and departments experiencing staff turnover will be raised, injecting a total of NT$5.3 billion. Including previously adjusted items, the cumulative injection now exceeds NT$10 billion, continuously strengthening the nation’s capacity for critical and acute medical care.

In the rare‑disease and new‑drug coverage segment, the administration will temporarily cover the oral medication Fabhalta (Fabhalta) for adult patients with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH), benefiting about 18‑28 individuals each year. It will also add Livmarli (Livmarli) to the reimbursement list for treating severe pruritus in patients with progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis (PFIC) and Alagille syndrome (ALGS), actively fulfilling its commitment to care for rare‑disease patients.
