items.title: 7月製造業燈號亮紅燈 2021年5月以來首見 超過4成產業景氣繁榮
items.title_en: July Manufacturing Sentiment Turns Red for First Time Since May 2021, Over 40% of Industries in Prosperity
paras: 台灣經濟研究院今(31)日公布7月製造業景氣信號值，較上月增加2.03分至18.57分，燈號由代表景氣揚升的黃紅燈轉為代表繁榮的紅燈，是2021年5月首見的紅燈，台經院表示，7月亮紅燈的產業占比高達45%。
7月景氣信號各主要組成項目中，4項分數增加、僅1項減少，使信號值增加2.03分，其中以經營環境面增加0.86分最多，需求面、原物料投入面和售價面分別增加0.71分、0.47分、0.04分，成本面則減少0.05分。
台經院指出，美歐和日本等經濟體受惠於半導體、高效能運算和AI等需求強勁，PMI維持於擴張區間，顯示全球製造業景氣仍具韌性。
在國內製造業方面，受惠於新興科技應用蓬勃發展、消費性電子新品備貨需求升溫，以及石化等傳統產業下游客戶拉貨意願改善，不僅出口價格持續揚升，外銷訂單和生產指數年增幅也擴大，帶動需求面、原物料投入面和售價面等指標。
而儘管7月台股下跌，但年增率仍維持高檔，同時，製造業廠商看好當月景氣的比例明顯上升，推升經營環境面指標。
就不同燈號的消長觀察，7月呈現衰退的藍燈比重僅0.28%，與6月持平；黃藍燈由8.31%減少至5.12%；綠燈由36.01%減少至17.69%；黃紅燈由29.24%增加至31.06%，繁榮的紅燈由26.15%明顯增加至45.85%。
展望後市，台經院提醒，因去年下半年基期偏高，可預期的是下半年成長幅度可能不及上半年，尤其是占出口40%的資通與視聽產品對美出口年增率由1月267.6%降至7月的28.0%，創2025年2月以來新低，此是否代表相關產業的成長力道已有收斂跡象，仍待觀察。
另一方面，部分傳統產業因資訊電子產業積極充產能及客戶回補庫存等需求而出現回溫，未來動能是否延續，成為支撐下半年經濟成長的另一來源。
paras_en: The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research released the July manufacturing sentiment index on the 31st, which rose 2.03 points to 18.57, shifting from the yellow‑red light that signals expansion to the red light that indicates prosperity – the first red light since May 2021. The institute noted that 45% of industries lit the red light in July.

In July, four of the main components of the sentiment index increased while only one decreased, adding 2.03 points. The largest gain came from the operating environment (+0.86 points), followed by demand (+0.71 points), raw material input (+0.47 points) and pricing (+0.04 points); cost fell slightly by 0.05 points.

The institute pointed out that economies such as the US, Europe and Japan benefited from strong demand for semiconductors, high‑performance computing and AI, keeping PMI in the expansion zone and showing global manufacturing resilience.

Domestically, emerging technology applications, rising demand for new consumer electronics inventory, and improved customer willingness to purchase in traditional petrochemical industries boosted export prices, foreign sales orders and production indices, driving up demand, raw material input and pricing indicators.

Although the Taiwan stock market fell in July, its year‑to‑date growth rate remained high, and manufacturers’ optimism about the month’s outlook rose sharply, lifting the operating environment indicator.

Regarding the distribution of light colors, the share of blue lights indicating contraction was only 0.28% in July, unchanged from June; yellow‑blue lights fell from 8.31% to 5.12%; green lights dropped from 36.01% to 17.69%; yellow‑red lights rose from 29.24% to 31.06%; and the prosperous red lights jumped from 26.15% to 45.85%.

Looking ahead, the institute cautions that because the base period in the second half of last year was high, growth in the latter half may lag behind the first half. In particular, the information‑communication and audiovisual products that account for 40% of exports saw their year‑to‑date growth rate fall from 267.6% in January to 28.0% in July – a new low since February 2025 – raising questions about whether the industry’s growth momentum has begun to converge.

Meanwhile, some traditional industries have warmed up due to the active capacity expansion and inventory replenishment in the information‑electronics sector. Whether this momentum continues will be another source of support for economic growth in the second half of the year.

items.title: 彭博：蘋果內部測試過折疊iPhone觸控筆
items.title_en: Bloomberg: Apple Internally Tested Foldable iPhone Pencil
paras: 在蘋果(AAPL-US) 9月新品發表會登場前，據《彭博》30日（周日）報導，蘋果在內部對適用於折疊iPhone的 觸控筆Apple Pencil進行過原型製作、測試，並考慮過推出這款產品。
但目前來看，Apple Pencil不太可能與新機同步上市。
蘋果測試的觸控筆原型比iPad所用版本更短，以適應手機獨特機身尺寸，並可透過磁吸方式固定在手機側面，同時實現收納和充電。
不過，折疊螢幕設計給觸控筆的使用帶來挑戰。觸控筆吸附在手機側面後，用戶展開設備時可能影響操作。
此外，折疊螢幕較脆弱，筆尖與螢幕接觸可能留下明顯痕跡。蘋果仍在權衡是否要推出這一配件。
蘋果共同創始人賈伯斯曾公開質疑手機觸控筆的必要性，此次內部測試可能意味著蘋果對這一產品形態的態度有所變化。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Before the Apple September 9 product launch, Bloomberg reported on Sunday the 30th that Apple had prototyped and tested an Apple Pencil designed for a foldable iPhone, and had considered launching the accessory.
However, the Apple Pencil is unlikely to debut alongside the new device.
The prototype pencil was shorter than the iPad version to fit the phone’s unique dimensions, and could be magnetically attached to the phone’s side for both storage and charging.
The foldable screen design poses challenges for the pencil’s use; once attached to the side, the pencil could interfere with the device when it is unfolded.
Additionally, the fragile foldable screen could show visible marks where the tip contacts the display, and Apple is still weighing whether to release the accessory.
Apple co‑founder Steve Jobs once publicly questioned the need for a phone stylus, so this internal testing may signal a shift in Apple’s stance on the product form factor.
(This article is not open for partner redistribution.)

items.title: AI泡沫離破裂還有多遠？《巴隆》揭「25法則」：美股漲勢可能還沒完
items.title_en: How Far Is the AI Bubble from Breaking? "Baron's" 25 Rules: US Stock Rally May Not Be Over
paras: 人工智慧（AI）資本支出狂潮持續擴大，科技巨頭未來兩年投資金額上看2兆美元，市場對「AI泡沫」的疑慮升溫。不過，《巴隆》援引歷史經驗指出，AI投資目前仍未觸及可能引爆危機的門檻，代表這波AI行情與美股漲勢或許還沒走到盡頭。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，隨著2026年進入最後4個月，標普500指數今年以來仍上漲約12%，但相較6月初僅小幅走高。在指數盤整時間拉長之際，投資人開始將注意力轉向市場潛在風險，其中最受關注的莫過於科技業者對人工智慧（AI）投入的龐大資本支出。
AI建設熱潮已推升企業資本支出至前所未見的水準。自2024年初以來，市場估計約有5000億美元投入晶片、3500億美元用於電力基礎設施、2000億美元投入建設工程，另有1000億美元用於網路設備。
這些支出的合計規模，已遠超過2021年所有標普500成分股的資本支出總額。當時標普500企業全年資本支出約5750億美元，而那甚至還是在ChatGPT問世前一年。
過去企業主要依靠自由現金流支應AI投資時，市場對資本支出狂潮的疑慮相對有限。但如今情況正在改變，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 、Meta(META-US) 及微軟(MSFT-US) 等大型科技公司開始透過舉債為AI資料中心提供資金，相關風險也逐漸反映在債務市場。
這些企業未來兩年的計畫投資金額約達2兆美元，與此同時，用於避險信用違約風險的保險成本已明顯攀升，顯示市場開始更加關注AI基礎建設背後的融資壓力。
股票市場同樣出現疑慮。AI相關企業股價從6月創下的52週高點回落約20%，讓投資人開始思考一個關鍵問題：即使AI基礎建設投資熱潮尚未結束，所謂的「AI交易」是否已經接近尾聲？
不過，歷史經驗未必支持這種判斷。
《巴隆》的分析提出一項可用來衡量技術投資熱潮的歷史標準，被稱為「25法則」。其核心概念是，在重大技術變革帶動的投資繁榮期間，美國經濟通常能夠吸收相當於經濟產出約25%的相關支出，之後才可能真正面臨難以承受的壓力。
例如，19世紀60年代鐵路建設熱潮初期，美國GDP每年約100億美元，最終鐵路相關支出累計達到約25億美元，之後才迎來1873年的經濟崩盤。
到了1990年代末網際網路泡沫時期，市場約投入1.5兆美元建設網際網路基礎設施，當時美國經濟規模約6兆美元，同樣接近這項歷史比例。20世紀20年代的工業化與電氣化投資，也呈現類似情況。
按照這項歷史標準，目前AI資本支出雖已達到驚人規模，但仍未達到相當於美國經濟產出25%的水準。
這代表，如果過去的技術投資週期可以作為參考，AI投資熱潮距離真正觸及可能引發崩潰的歷史門檻，可能還需要一段時間，因此AI行情及美股這波漲勢或許仍有進一步走高的空間。
雷蒙詹姆斯（Raymond James）策略師Tavis McCourt指出，歷史上的資本支出繁榮通常不會自行結束，而是需要某種外部衝擊成為轉折點，例如聯準會（Fed）升息等政策因素，或1906年舊金山大地震等重大事件，都可能成為推動市場反轉的催化劑。
梅利厄斯研究（Melius Research）技術研究主管Ben Reitzes則認為，AI投資週期仍有望持續發展。他表示，這波浪潮的規模與持續時間可能都會超出市場原先預期。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) capital spending is expanding at a feverish pace, with tech giants projected to invest $2 trillion over the next two years, raising concerns about an "AI bubble." However, "Baron's" historical analysis suggests that AI investment has not yet reached the threshold that could trigger a crisis, implying that the current AI rally and the US stock market may still have room to grow.

According to "Baron's Weekly," as 2026 enters its final four months, the S&P 500 has risen about 12% this year, but only modestly higher than early June. As the index consolidates, investors are turning their attention to potential risks, with the biggest concern being the massive capital outlays by tech firms for AI.

The AI build‑out frenzy has pushed corporate capital expenditures to unprecedented levels. Since early 2024, roughly $500 billion has been allocated to chips, $350 billion to power infrastructure, $200 billion to construction projects, and an additional $100 billion to networking equipment.

These expenditures far exceed the total capital spend of all S&P 500 constituents in 2021. At that time, S&P 500 companies spent about $575 billion on capital outlays, even before ChatGPT was launched.

In the past, companies relied on free cash flow to fund AI, and concerns about the spending spree were limited. Today, the situation is changing as Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) begin to borrow to finance AI data centers, and the associated risks are increasingly reflected in the debt market.

These firms plan to invest roughly $2 trillion over the next two years, while insurance costs to hedge credit‑default risk have risen sharply, indicating that the market is paying more attention to the financing pressure behind AI infrastructure.

The stock market has also shown concern. AI‑related shares have fallen about 20% from their June 52‑week highs, prompting investors to question whether the so‑called "AI boom" is already nearing its end, even if the infrastructure investment wave is still ongoing.
However, historical experience does not necessarily support that judgment.

Baron's analysis proposes a historical benchmark for measuring technology‑investment booms, called the "25 Rule." The core idea is that during periods of major technological change, the US economy can absorb roughly 25% of the related spending before it may face unsustainable pressure.

For example, in the early 1860s, the railroad construction boom saw the US GDP at about $10 billion per year, with railroad‑related spending eventually totaling about $2.5 billion, before the 1873 economic collapse.

By the late 1990s, during the internet bubble, the market invested about $1.5 trillion in internet infrastructure, while the US economy was roughly $6 trillion, again close to this historical ratio. The industrialization and electrification of the 1920s also showed a similar pattern.
According to this historical standard, current AI capital spending, while staggering, has not yet reached 25% of US economic output.

This means that if past technology‑investment cycles are a guide, the AI boom is still a distance away from hitting the historical threshold that could trigger a collapse, leaving room for the AI rally and the US stock market to climb further.

Raymond James strategist Tavis McCourt notes that capital‑spending booms rarely end on their own; they usually require an external shock—such as a Fed rate hike or a major event like the 1906 San Francisco earthquake—to trigger a reversal.
Ben Reitzes, chief technology researcher at Melius Research, believes the AI investment cycle can still continue, saying the scale and duration of this wave may exceed market expectations.

items.title: 摩根士丹利點名「5檔」AI主權概念股！SpaceX目標價300美元、潛在漲幅105%
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Names Five AI Sovereignty Stocks—SpaceX Target Price $300, Potential Upside 105%
paras: 摩根士丹利認為，人工智慧主權（AI sovereignty）已成為攸關國家安全與經濟實力的關鍵因素。全球各國政府正積極支持國內AI基礎設施建設，為部分全球企業創造受惠於這波趨勢的機會。該行亦列出5檔較目前價格至少具20%潛在上漲空間的股票。
根據《Business Insider》報導，AI的重要性已不僅限於投資報酬與企業獲利，更攸關國家安全。摩根士丹利指出，這項趨勢正成為AI產業中特定類型股票的催化劑。
各國政府正介入市場，以確保自身在AI競賽中取得優勢，目標是掌握AI技術的自主控制權，同時降低對外國企業的依賴。
摩根士丹利將這項投資主題稱為「AI主權」。由Arianna Salvatore領導的分析團隊發布研究報告指出：「AI正日益成為戰略性基礎設施，促使各國政府更加重視國內產能、可信賴的合作夥伴，以及更嚴格的科技管制。」
該行指出：「隨著AI逐漸成為國家經濟與地緣政治競爭的工具，美國政府可能將運算能力、資料、能源、人才、基礎模型及供應鏈的自主能力列為優先事項。」
這代表，各國政府將在降低對海外技術依賴的同時，推動國內AI基礎設施發展。從更廣泛的角度來看，這也代表各國需要擴充與AI相關的硬體及軟體資源。
報告進一步指出，實現AI自主能力，需要興建更多國內及區域資料中心、提升系統備援能力、擴大發電與輸電容量、建立本地化的雲端與網路基礎設施，並在部分情況下打造平行的技術架構。
摩根士丹利認為，目前的產業環境仍將有利於特定AI相關企業，並形容AI主權是「市場上成長最快的投資主題之一」。

摩根士丹利點名5檔美股　SpaceX潛在漲幅105%

在AI主權與科技在地化趨勢下，摩根士丹利列出一批最有機會受惠的股票，其中5檔美國掛牌股票的基本情境目標價，均較目前價格至少具20%潛在上漲空間，而「核心邏輯股」代表與AI主權趨勢的關聯度最高，其次則為「關鍵股」。
在5檔股票中，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 被列為「核心邏輯股」，摩根士丹利給予「加碼」評級，目標價300美元，基本情境潛在漲幅達105%。
另一檔「核心邏輯股」是安可(AMKR-US) 。摩根士丹利給予「等權重」評級，目標價70美元，潛在漲幅26%。
此外，半導體設備業者ACM Research(ACMR-US) 同樣被列為「核心邏輯股」，摩根士丹利給予「加碼」評級，目標價130美元，潛在漲幅達60%。
除了上述3檔「核心邏輯股」，摩根士丹利也將阿里巴巴(BABA-US) 與半導體設備商科磊(KLAC-US) 列為「關鍵股」。
阿里巴巴獲摩根士丹利「加碼」評級，目標價180美元，基本情境潛在漲幅44%；科磊則獲「加碼」評級，目標價253美元，潛在漲幅21%。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley believes AI sovereignty has become a key factor for national security and economic strength. Governments worldwide are actively supporting domestic AI infrastructure, creating opportunities for certain global firms to benefit from this trend. The firm also lists five stocks that currently have at least a 20% potential upside from their current prices.

According to Business Insider, the importance of AI extends beyond investment returns and corporate profits to national security. Morgan Stanley notes that this trend is becoming a catalyst for specific types of AI industry stocks.
Governments are intervening in the market to secure an advantage in the AI race, aiming to control AI technology autonomously while reducing reliance on foreign companies.

Morgan Stanley calls this investment theme "AI sovereignty." An analysis team led by Arianna Salvatore released a research report stating: "AI is increasingly becoming strategic infrastructure, prompting governments to focus more on domestic capacity, reliable partners, and stricter technology controls."

The firm points out that as AI becomes a tool for national economic and geopolitical competition, the U.S. government may prioritize autonomous capabilities in computing power, data, energy, talent, foundational models, and supply chains.

This means governments will reduce dependence on overseas technology while promoting domestic AI infrastructure development. More broadly, it indicates a need to expand AI-related hardware and software resources.

The report further notes that achieving AI autonomy requires building more domestic and regional data centers, enhancing system redundancy, expanding power generation and transmission capacity, establishing localized cloud and network infrastructure, and in some cases creating parallel technology architectures.
Morgan Stanley believes the current industry environment will still favor certain AI-related companies and describes AI sovereignty as one of the fastest-growing investment themes in the market.

Morgan Stanley names five U.S. stocks that stand to benefit most under the AI sovereignty and technology localization trend. These five U.S. listed stocks have at least a 20% potential upside from their current prices, with "core logic stocks" having the highest correlation to the AI sovereignty trend, followed by "key stocks."
Among the five stocks, SpaceX (SPCX-US) is listed as a "core logic stock." Morgan Stanley gives it a "buy more" rating, a target price of $300, and a potential upside of 105%.
Another "core logic stock" is Anker (AMKR-US). Morgan Stanley gives it a "equal weight" rating, a target price of $70, and a potential upside of 26%.

Additionally, semiconductor equipment provider ACM Research (ACMR-US) is also listed as a "core logic stock." Morgan Stanley gives it a "buy more" rating, a target price of $130, and a potential upside of 60%.
Besides the above three "core logic stocks," Morgan Stanley also lists Alibaba (BABA-US) and semiconductor equipment maker KLA (KLAC-US) as "key stocks."

Alibaba receives a "buy more" rating from Morgan Stanley, a target price of $180, and a potential upside of 44%; KLA receives a "buy more" rating, a target price of $253, and a potential upside of 21%.

items.title: 台積電代工價喊漲10%至15%？AI狂潮推升議價權、回檔成佈局機會
items.title_en: TSMC's Foundry Prices Hike 10%–15%? AI Frenzy Boosts Bargaining Power, Pullback Creates Layout Opportunity
paras: 人工智慧（AI）晶片需求持續強勁，正重新改變全球晶圓代工市場的定價格局。三星電子(005930KS) 率先調高部分先進與成熟製程報價後，市場預期台積電(2330-TW) 也將跟進，旗下各製程價格可能全面上調10%至15%。
分析指出，在先進產能供不應求、AI需求強勁的背景下，晶圓代工龍頭的議價能力正進一步提升。根據TrendForce與野村證券報告，台積電今年年中已與客戶完成新一輪價格協商，調漲下半年供需吃緊的部分3奈米（N3）製程最高15%。
市場進一步預期，最晚至2027年初，台積電N2、N3及N5等先進製程價格還可能再調升5%至10%。
這波漲價預期也迅速反映在台積電估值上，花旗、美銀及麥格理等華爾街機構陸續調高目標價，最高上看4200元新台幣。
市場認為，AI晶片的剛性需求，加上台積電議價能力提升，有望進一步推升公司及供應鏈的長期獲利。

台積電先進製程滿載　成熟製程也醞釀漲價

此次晶圓代工價格上漲，核心原因在於先進製程產能持續吃緊。市場資訊顯示，台積電N2與N3產能幾乎已被蘋果(AAPL-US) 與輝達(NVDA-US) 預訂。
此外，隨著英特爾(INTC-US) 為2027年初推出的新一代Nova Lake桌上型處理器增加台積電N2X製程採購，先進製程供應壓力可能進一步升高。
在先進製程供不應求的情況下，漲價也可能從N3等熱門節點擴大至其他製程。市場研究指出，除N3外，台積電連續3年未調價的N12、N16及N28等成熟製程，價格也可能同步調升，最高漲幅約10%，代表台積電自今年下半年起，將逐步且全面地調漲旗下所有代工晶片價格。
花旗證券認為，全球科技大廠持續拉貨AI晶片，將使台積電先進製程維持高利用率，尤其N2與N3的強勁需求，可望支撐代工價格一路維持至2027年。
市場資料顯示，台積電N2每片晶圓起始價格已達3萬美元，較N3高出約10%至20%。

台積電加大擴產　資本支出明年估達800億美元

面對AI晶片需求，台積電也持續擴大資本支出，以維持相較三星和英特爾技術與產能優勢。
里昂證券預估，台積電2027年資本支出將達800億美元，2028年進一步增加至900億美元。今年資本支出則已上調至520億至560億美元，創下歷史新高。
台積電7月也宣布擴大美國投資至2650億美元，計畫在亞利桑那州布局多座晶圓廠及先進封裝廠。
產能擴張與議價能力提升，也推升華爾街對台積電未來獲利的預期。美銀、高盛及花旗等機構普遍看好台積電2026年至2028年的獲利表現，預估2026年每股盈餘（EPS）將突破100元新台幣，2028年則有機會達到170至200元新台幣。
目前多數機構給予台積電「買入」或「優於大盤」評級，目標價中位數約落在3700至3800元新台幣。
台積電擴產也同步帶動半導體設備、材料及無塵室等供應鏈需求，相關企業今年前7個月營收維持雙位數成長，產業能見度延伸至2027年以後。
儘管台積電近期受到費城半導體指數走弱拖累，股價一度回落至2375元新台幣，但市場機構認為，考慮到公司營收持續改寫新高，加上代工價格可望全面調升10%至15%，股價回檔反而提供布局機會。

三星率先漲價　AI需求成代工議價關鍵

事實上，在台積電可能全面調價之前，三星已率先採取行動。
根據《路透》報導，三星電子7月已調高部分先進製程代工新訂單價格。其中，4奈米（SF4）製程針對中國與美國客戶的漲幅達10%至15%，5奈米（SF5）價格也上調10%至15%，8奈米製程則調漲近10%。
三星此次調價，被市場視為晶圓代工產業定價權正在回升的訊號。
Counterpoint數據顯示，2026年第1季台積電占全球晶圓代工營收的市占率約73%，三星約7%，中芯國際(00981-HK) 約5%。三星代工部門自2022年以來持續虧損，但隨著AI晶片需求增加，其客戶與訂單規模正逐步擴大。
特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與蘋果去年先後與三星簽署晶片製造協議；今年7月，三星宣布與博通(AVGO-US) 合作生產AI晶片。輝達執行長黃仁勳今年3月也表示，三星將為其新款AI推理處理器提供代工服務，Google(GOOGL-US) 則正在與三星洽談採用SF4製程生產晶片。
三星預期，今年先進製程占代工營收比重將超過一半，AI與高效能運算（HPC）應用占比也將突破30%，高於2025年底的15%至20%。
三星位於韓國平澤的SF4產線自去年底以來持續滿載，除為高通(QCOM-US) 等客戶生產邏輯晶片，也為三星自家的多層高頻寬記憶體（HBM）生產基礎晶片。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) chip demand remains strong, reshaping the global wafer‑foundry pricing landscape. Samsung Electronics (005930KS) was the first to raise prices for some advanced and mature processes, prompting market expectations that TSMC (2330‑TW) will follow suit, potentially raising all its process prices by 10% to 15%.

Analysts point out that with advanced capacity in short supply and AI demand robust, the pricing power of wafer‑foundry leaders is further enhanced. According to TrendForce and Nomura Securities, TSMC has already completed a new round of price negotiations with customers mid‑year, raising the 3‑nanometer (N3) process—where supply will tighten in the second half of the year—by up to 15%.
The market further expects that by early 2027, TSMC’s N2, N3 and N5 advanced processes could see another 5% to 10% price increase.

This price‑rise expectation quickly reflected in TSMC’s valuation, with Citi, Bank of America and Macquarie among Wall Street firms gradually lifting target prices, with a high of 4,200 New Taiwan dollars.
The market believes that the rigid demand for AI chips, coupled with TSMC’s improved bargaining power, will further lift the company’s and its supply chain’s long‑term profitability.

TSMC’s advanced processes are fully booked while mature processes are also primed for price hikes. The core reason for the wafer‑foundry price increase is the continued tightening of advanced process capacity. Market data shows that TSMC’s N2 and N3 capacity is almost fully booked by Apple (AAPL‑US) and NVIDIA (NVDA‑US).

In addition, as Intel (INTC‑US) plans to launch its next‑generation Nova Lake desktop processor in early 2027, it will increase orders for TSMC’s N2X process, potentially raising pressure on advanced process supply.

With advanced processes in short supply, price hikes may also spread from popular nodes like N3 to other processes. Market research indicates that, aside from N3, TSMC’s mature processes—N12, N16 and N28—which have not seen price changes for three consecutive years, could also see price increases of up to 10%, signaling that from the second half of this year TSMC will gradually and comprehensively raise prices for all its foundry chips.

Citi Securities believes that global tech giants will continue to pull AI chips, keeping TSMC’s advanced processes at high utilization, especially the strong demand for N2 and N3, which should support foundry prices through 2027.
Market data shows that TSMC’s N2 price per wafer starts at $30,000, 10% to 20% higher than N3.
Facing AI chip demand, TSMC continues to expand capital expenditure to maintain its technological and capacity advantage over Samsung and Intel.

Leon Securities estimates that TSMC’s capital expenditure will reach $80 billion in 2027 and further increase to $90 billion in 2028. This year’s capex has already been raised to $52 billion to $56 billion, setting a new historical high.
In July, TSMC also announced expanding its U.S. investment to $265 billion, planning to build multiple fabs and advanced packaging plants in Arizona.

Capacity expansion and improved bargaining power also boost Wall Street’s expectations for TSMC’s future earnings. Bank of America, Goldman Sachs and Citi generally view TSMC’s earnings from 2026 to 2028 positively, estimating EPS to exceed 100 New Taiwan dollars in 2026 and potentially reach 170 to 200 New Taiwan dollars in 2028.
Most institutions currently rate TSMC as “Buy” or “Outperform the market,” with a median target price around 3,700 to 3,800 New Taiwan dollars.

TSMC’s expansion also drives demand for semiconductor equipment, materials and clean‑room supplies, with related companies reporting double‑digit revenue growth in the first seven months of the year, extending industry visibility beyond 2027.

Although TSMC has recently been dragged down by a weak Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, its stock fell to 2,375 New Taiwan dollars, market institutions believe that given the company’s revenue continues to set new highs and foundry prices are expected to rise 10% to 15% across the board, the pullback actually offers a layout opportunity.
Samsung was the first to raise prices, with AI demand being the key to foundry bargaining power. In fact, before TSMC potentially raises all prices, Samsung has already taken action.

According to Reuters, Samsung Electronics raised prices for some advanced process foundry new orders in July. The 4‑nanometer (SF4) process saw a 10% to 15% price increase for Chinese and U.S. customers, the 5‑nanometer (SF5) process also increased by 10% to 15%, and the 8‑nanometer process increased by nearly 10%.
Samsung’s price hike is seen by the market as a signal that wafer‑foundry pricing power is returning.

Counterpoint data shows that in Q1 2026, TSMC’s share of global wafer‑foundry revenue was about 73%, Samsung about 7%, and SMIC (00981‑HK) about 5%. Samsung’s foundry division has been losing money since 2022, but as AI chip demand grows, its customers and order volumes are gradually expanding.

Tesla (TSLA‑US) and Apple signed chip manufacturing agreements with Samsung last year; in July, Samsung announced a partnership with Broadcom (AVGO‑US) to produce AI chips. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said in March that Samsung would provide foundry services for its new AI inference processors, and Google (GOOGL‑US) is negotiating with Samsung to use the SF4 process to produce chips.

Samsung expects that advanced processes will account for more than half of its foundry revenue this year, with AI and high‑performance computing (HPC) applications surpassing 30% of revenue, higher than the 15% to 20% projected for the end of 2025.

Samsung’s SF4 line in Pyeongtaek, South Korea has been running at full capacity since the end of last year, producing logic chips for customers such as Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) and also producing base chips for Samsung’s own multi‑layer high‑bandwidth memory (HBM).

items.title: SpaceX股價要噴？大摩喊300美元、看好1000億美元新基地成AI太空新引擎
items.title_en: Will SpaceX Stock Surge? Morgan Stanley Calls $300 Target, Backs $100B New Base as AI‑Space Engine
paras: 摩根士丹利(MS-US) 分析師Adam Jonas本週發布報告指出，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 計畫斥資1000億美元，在美國路易斯安那州Vermilion Parish打造新的Starbase發射基地的這項計畫，可能成為推動SpaceX股價進一步上漲的新催化劑。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Jonas認為，投資人目前似乎仍未充分反映SpaceX大規模擴張火箭業務所帶來的潛在機會。
Jonas寫道：「我們認為，投資人目前擁有一個獨特機會，可以在接近IPO發行價的水準重新關注SpaceX股票，而該公司在太空、互聯互通與企業AI等業務的基本面動能，甚至可能比過去更強。」
SpaceX新發射基地預計明年開始動工，首批發射任務則將於2029年展開。
Jonas補充，SpaceX近期公布第2季財報後，其團隊對SpaceX股票的展望已大幅改善。儘管公司預測資本支出將提高，財報公布後股價一度因此承壓，但他的團隊對SpaceX股票的展望已顯著改善。
他表示，財報公布後，投資人如今掌握更多資訊，可以觀察SpaceX股票在首輪禁售期結束後的實際表現；而禁售期屆滿後，股價並未面臨市場原先擔心的那麼大的賣壓。
摩根士丹利認為，SpaceX位於路易斯安那州的新發射基地，可能成為推動公司股價上漲的新催化劑。
Jonas表示：「我們認為，投資人尚未充分認識SpaceX在星艦（Starship）上的布局規模。」他指出，按照摩根士丹利對2028會計年度的預測，SpaceX目前估值具吸引力，股價相當於預估營收的10倍，對應70%的成長；以息稅前利潤（EBIT）計算則為25倍，對應113%的成長。
摩根士丹利的樂觀看法，與部分知名投資人的看法形成對比。這些投資人認為，馬斯克旗下這家火箭與AI公司目前估值過高。避險基金億萬富豪David Einhorn在最新致投資人的信中，也對SpaceX持看空態度。
不過，Jonas將焦點放在SpaceX將火箭送入太空的能力。他認為，新發射基地將協助SpaceX持續擴大發射規模，完工後可能成為公司迄今最大的基地，並支援每年數千次發射。
他也指出，新基地的選址本身就是一項優勢。
Jonas解釋說：「路易斯安那州在經由墨西哥灣向南發射方面也具備獨特的地理優勢。若從佛羅里達州、德州或加州進行類似發射，將難以避開人口密集區域；相較之下，這使SpaceX得以擴大進入從黎明至黃昏的太陽同步極軌，而這類軌道與軌道運算有直接關聯。」
摩根士丹利目前給予SpaceX股票「加碼」評級，目標價為每股300美元。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (MS-US) analyst Adam Jonas released a report this week stating that SpaceX’s (SPCX-US) plan to spend $100 billion on a new Starbase launch facility in Vermilion Parish, Louisiana could become a fresh catalyst for further upside in the stock.
According to Business Insider, Jonas believes investors have not yet fully priced in the potential upside from SpaceX’s massive expansion of its rocket business.

Jonas wrote: “We think investors now have a unique opportunity to re‑focus on SpaceX shares at levels close to the IPO price, and the fundamental momentum in the company’s space, connectivity and enterprise AI businesses may even be stronger than before.”
The new launch site is slated to break ground next year, with the first launch missions expected to commence in 2029.

Jonas added that after SpaceX’s recent Q2 earnings release, his team’s outlook on the stock has improved markedly. Although the company forecast higher capital expenditures, which briefly pressured the share price after the results, the team’s view on the stock has since brightened considerably.

He said that post‑earnings, investors now have more information and can watch how the stock performs after the initial lock‑up period ends; once the lock‑up expires, the price has not faced the heavy selling pressure the market originally feared.
Morgan Stanley believes the new Louisiana launch base could act as a new catalyst for the company’s share price appreciation.

Jonas said: “We think investors have not fully appreciated the scale of SpaceX’s Starship rollout.” He noted that, based on Morgan Stanley’s FY2028 forecasts, SpaceX is currently attractively valued at roughly 10 times estimated revenue (implying 70% growth) and about 25 times EBIT (implying 113% growth).

Morgan Stanley’s bullish stance contrasts with several well‑known investors who view Elon Musk’s rocket‑and‑AI firm as overvalued. Hedge‑fund billionaire David Einhorn, in his latest letter to investors, also takes a bearish view on SpaceX.

However, Jonas focuses on SpaceX’s ability to get rockets into space. He believes the new launch site will help the company continue scaling its launch cadence, potentially becoming its largest facility to date and supporting thousands of launches per year once completed.
He also pointed out that the site’s location itself is an advantage.

Jonas explained: “Louisiana offers a unique geographic advantage for southward launches over the Gulf of Mexico. Launches from Florida, Texas or California would struggle to avoid densely populated areas; by contrast, this allows SpaceX to expand into sun‑synchronous polar orbits from dawn to dusk, which are directly tied to orbital computation.”
Morgan Stanley currently rates SpaceX stock with an “Overweight” recommendation and a target price of $300 per share.

items.title: 橋水達里歐改口建議持有比特幣！分析：想靠它避險恐怕「錯了」
paras: 橋水基金（Bridgewater Associates）創辦人達里歐（Ray Dalio）近年對比特幣（BTC）的態度出現轉變，從過去認為比特幣是「泡沫」，到如今建議投資人配置少量比特幣。不過，這項建議也引發質疑，分析認為比特幣與股市走勢高度連動，若投資人是為了降低債務危機或熊市風險而配置比特幣，恐怕難以達到避險效果；相較之下，黃金可能更適合扮演分散投資組合風險的角色。
根據《The Motley Fool》報導，2017年時，達利歐曾將比特幣形容為「泡沫」，並認為比特幣「不是有效的財富儲存工具」。如今，他對這項加密貨幣的看法則明顯較為正面。
他近日發表文章指出，考慮到多數經濟體都面臨債務與財政赤字問題，投資人可以在投資組合中「持有一點比特幣」。
達利歐認為，像比特幣這類非政府發行的貨幣，可以成為因應相關風險的一種方式，並預期其表現相對不錯。
至於所謂「一點」究竟是多少，達利歐過去曾表示，投資組合配置最多約2%比特幣是合理做法。
不過，分析人士指出，從風險分散角度來看，比特幣是否真的適合作為避險資產，仍存在疑問。

比特幣與股市連動　債務危機下未必能發揮避險作用

達利歐是在回答投資人如何因應債務危機風險，以及未來應如何配置投資組合時，提出持有比特幣的建議的。
值得注意的是，達利歐首先提到的其實是黃金，並建議配置10%至15%黃金以降低投資組合風險。儘管比特幣經常被稱為「數位黃金」，但兩者在市場表現上仍存在明顯差異。
比特幣通常與股票朝相同方向波動。根據《Motley Fool》近期研究，2016年至2025年的10年間，標普500指數與比特幣有8年走勢方向一致。
其中2022年熊市尤其明顯，比特幣當年跌幅約為標普500的3倍。分析認為這代表，若債務危機進一步衝擊股市，比特幣可能同步下跌，甚至面臨更大的跌幅。
黃金與股票的情況則有所不同，兩者通常呈現反向走勢。2022年股市進入熊市期間，黃金仍成功維持價值，全年小幅上漲0.3%。
因此，如果投資人主要目的是降低熊市期間的投資組合損失，黃金可能比比特幣更能發揮分散風險的作用。

比特幣仍具配置價值　但並非投資組合必備

儘管如此，比特幣仍可能成為部分投資人的投資組合配置選項。
如果投資人希望參與數位資產市場，同時具備較高風險承受能力，比特幣可以成為投資組合的一部分。雖然價格波動極為劇烈，但比特幣在部分時期也曾大幅跑贏市場，包括2024年與2025年。
報導指出，對有興趣配置比特幣的投資人而言，可以直接投資比特幣，或透過比特幣ETF參與市場。按照達利歐過去提出的原則，將比特幣配置控制在投資組合2%以內，仍屬相對合理的範圍。
至於具備加密貨幣投資經驗、且風險承受能力較高的投資人，配置比例可能進一步提高，甚至延伸至其他加密貨幣，但鑑於這類資產價格波動劇烈，控制整體曝險程度仍相當重要。
對於不追求數位資產曝險的投資人而言，單靠股票與債券同樣可以建立多元化投資組合。換言之，比特幣可以考慮，但並非不可或缺；如果核心目標是降低投資風險，比特幣未必是最佳選擇。

items.title: 輝達AI行情續強Alphabet、Meta為何陷危機？美股七巨頭分化加劇
items.title_en: NVIDIA AI Momentum Continues, Why Alphabet and Meta Face Crisis? US Market Leaders Diverge
paras: 「美股七巨頭」（Magnificent Seven）不再是推動股市上漲的絕對主力，但今年以來各家企業股價與基本面的分化程度，卻格外明顯。其中，輝達(NVDA-US) 持續受惠於AI熱潮，股價再度受到市場追捧；反觀Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 與Meta(META-US) ，則因AI資本支出、現金流及商業化進展等疑慮承受沉重賣壓。
根據《Business Insider》報導，輝達最新財報再次證明AI交易仍具韌性。公司公布亮眼業績及對未來成長的樂觀展望後，股價週四（27日）盤中一度上漲10%，2026年以來累計漲幅達23%。
在市值已達5.5兆美元、成為全球最大企業的情況下，輝達仍能持續交出強勁營收與成長預期，進一步強化市場對AI需求的信心。
然而，相較之下，Alphabet與Meta的投資故事正在出現變化。

Alphabet市值3個月蒸發6920億美元　AI支出成市場焦點

Alphabet今年初一度是「七巨頭」中的異數，當其他大型雲端業者股價承壓時，Alphabet仍逆勢走高。但如今情況已經反轉，股價較5月高點下跌15%，上週五收於346.59美元，過去3個月市值蒸發6920億美元。
儘管如此，Alphabet今年以來仍維持約7%的漲幅。
市場對Alphabet最大的疑慮之一，是AI資本支出快速膨脹。公司今年AI相關支出預計最高達2050億美元，明顯高於先前預估的1800億至1900億美元。
Siebert Financial投資長Mark Malek指出，Alphabet持續擴大AI基礎建設投資已成為市場關注核心。雖然雲端業務成長依然強勁，但投資人希望看到不斷增加的資本支出最終轉化為具體的獲利成長。
此外，Alphabet近期也面臨高層人事變動。8月，Google前首席科學家Jeff Dean離開公司創辦AI新創；Google DeepMind前執行長Demis Hassabis則卸下原職，轉任更廣泛的公司職務。相關重組消息公布當日，Alphabet股價隨即下跌。
AI產品進度也成為市場疑慮之一。Alphabet新一代AI模型Gemini 3.5 Pro延後推出，外界預期該模型將強化程式設計工具，而這正是Alphabet被認為落後競爭對手的領域。

Meta股價較高點跌27%　AI燒錢與現金流雙重承壓

Meta的股價表現則更加疲弱。公司股價較2025年8月高點下跌27%，上週五收於578.02美元，過去一年市值已蒸發超過5000億美元。
與Alphabet類似，Meta面臨的核心問題同樣是AI投資規模。
Meta今年資本支出預計最高達1450億美元，高於先前預估的1150億至1350億美元。雖然公司持續加碼AI，但其商業化模式目前仍處於早期階段。
Meta今年5月宣布針對AI模型及核心社群服務推出訂閱方案，但相較之下，Alphabet、微軟(MSFT-US) 及亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 的AI商業化路徑似乎更加明確。
eToro投資及選擇權分析師Bret Kenwell指出，Meta目前仍存在不少問號，市場除了關注其支出規模，也會考慮公司過去元宇宙投資帶來的龐大損失。Meta此前因元宇宙相關計畫累計認列逾800億美元損失。
更大的壓力來自現金流。Meta最新財報顯示，第2季自由現金流暴跌91%至7.84億美元。
此外，Meta本週同意以180億美元和解青少年成癮訴訟，Needham分析師認為，這項現金支出出現的時間點格外不利，因為Meta正需要資金追趕規模更大的AI競爭對手。
分析師也警告，和解協議要求Meta針對青少年使用者推出每日2小時等限制功能，可能進一步帶來用戶流失風險。

「七巨頭」輪動仍持續　市場等待AI投資帶來實質成長

「七巨頭」內部的強弱輪動並非新現象。Kenwell指出，過去Alphabet也曾是這群科技巨頭中的「超級明星」，如今則輪到其他成員受到市場青睞。
關鍵在於，投資人並不一定要求Alphabet與Meta立即證明AI投資能帶來巨額回報，而是希望看到清楚的成長路徑。
其他「七巨頭」企業今年夏季同樣曾遭遇股價回檔，但在市場看到業務出現「實質加速」後，股價重新反彈。
因此，Alphabet與Meta未來能否重新獲得投資人青睞，關鍵可能不在於AI投資何時完全回本，而是市場何時能看到這些龐大支出開始轉化為可持續的營收與成長動能。
paras_en: The "Magnificent Seven" are no longer the sole drivers of the US stock market, but the divergence in stock prices and fundamentals among these companies has become particularly pronounced this year. NVIDIA (NVDA-US) continues to benefit from the AI boom, with its shares again attracting market support, while Alphabet (GOOGL-US) and Meta (META-US) face heavy selling pressure due to concerns over AI capital expenditures, cash flow, and commercialization progress.

According to a Business Insider report, NVIDIA’s latest earnings further confirm the resilience of AI trading. After announcing strong results and an optimistic outlook for future growth, the stock rose as much as 10% intraday on Thursday (27th) and has climbed 23% since 2026.
With a market cap of $5.5 trillion, making it the world’s largest company, NVIDIA continues to deliver robust revenue and growth expectations, further strengthening market confidence in AI demand.
In contrast, Alphabet and Meta’s investment stories are changing.

Alphabet’s market cap has evaporated $69.2 billion over the past three months, as AI spending becomes a market focus. Alphabet was once an outlier among the Magnificent Seven early this year, rising against the pressure on other large cloud players, but the situation has now reversed, with the stock falling 15% from its May high to close at $346.59 last Friday.
Despite this, Alphabet has maintained a roughly 7% gain year‑to‑date.

One of the biggest concerns for Alphabet is the rapid expansion of AI capital expenditures. The company now expects AI‑related spending to reach as high as $205 billion this year, clearly above the previous estimate of $180–190 billion.

Mark Malek, chief investment officer at Siebert Financial, noted that Alphabet’s continued expansion of AI infrastructure investment has become a market focal point. While cloud business growth remains strong, investors want to see the increasing capital spend ultimately translate into concrete profit growth.

Alphabet also recently faced senior personnel changes. In August, former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean left the company to start an AI startup, and former DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis stepped down from his role to take on a broader company position. The share price fell immediately after the restructuring news was announced.

AI product progress has also become a market concern. Alphabet’s next‑generation AI model Gemini 3.5 Pro was delayed, and the market expected the model to enhance programming tools, an area where Alphabet is perceived to lag behind competitors.

Meta’s stock performance has been even weaker. The company’s shares have fallen 27% from the August 2025 high, closing at $578.02 last Friday, and its market cap has declined by more than $500 billion over the past year.
Like Alphabet, Meta’s core issue is the scale of AI investment.

Meta expects capital expenditures to reach as high as $145 billion this year, above the previous estimate of $115–135 billion. Although the company continues to ramp up AI, its commercialization model remains in early stages.

In May, Meta announced subscription plans for AI models and core community services, but compared to Alphabet, Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Amazon (AMZN-US), Meta’s AI commercialization path seems less clear.

Bret Kenwell, an analyst at eToro, noted that Meta still has many questions. In addition to the size of its spend, the market also considers the massive losses from past metaverse investments. Meta has recorded over $80 billion in losses from metaverse‑related projects.
Even greater pressure comes from cash flow. Meta’s latest earnings show a 91% plunge in free cash flow to $784 million in Q2.

Meta also agreed to settle a youth addiction lawsuit for $18 billion this week. Needham analyst believes the timing of this cash outlay is particularly unfavorable, as Meta needs capital to catch up with larger AI competitors.
Analysts also warn that the settlement requires Meta to introduce a daily two‑hour limit for young users, potentially increasing user churn risk.
The rotation within the Magnificent Seven continues. Kenwell noted that Alphabet was once a “super‑star” among these tech giants, but now other members are gaining market favor.
The key is that investors do not necessarily require Alphabet and Meta to prove AI investment yields massive returns immediately; they want to see a clear growth path.
Other Magnificent Seven companies also experienced stock pullbacks this summer, but when the market saw tangible acceleration in their businesses, the shares rebounded.

Therefore, whether Alphabet and Meta can regain investor favor in the future may hinge not on when AI investment fully pays off, but on when the market sees these massive expenditures begin to translate into sustainable revenue and growth momentum.

items.title: A記憶體價格超越一顆頂級SoC！Gartner上修2026年營收至8373億美元、占半導體市場54%
items.title_en: Memory Prices Surpass a Top‑End SoC! Gartner Raises 2026 Revenue Forecast to $837.3 B, Accounting for 54% of the Semiconductor Market
paras: 人工智慧（AI）浪潮正重新改寫半導體產業的供需結構，過去高度仰賴景氣循環、價格波動劇烈的記憶體市場，如今因高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求爆發，以及大型雲端服務商提前鎖定產能，逐漸從傳統「商品型」半導體轉變為AI基礎建設的核心環節。
Gartner 4月預估，全球記憶體營收將從2025年的2163億美元，大增至2026年的6333億美元，占整體1.32兆美元半導體市場約48%。
到了8月，Gartner進一步上修預測，預估2026年記憶體營收將達8373億美元，占整體1.56兆美元半導體市場比重更攀升至54%。
換言之，記憶體在半導體產業中的地位已大幅提升，AI帶動的HBM需求成為這波市場重估的重要推力。

AI需求爆發　科技巨頭提前多年鎖定記憶體

AI對記憶體需求的影響，不僅反映在市場預測，也直接體現在晶片業者的採購行為。
輝達(NVDA-US) 單季供應鏈與產能預付承諾，就從1190億美元大幅增加至2790億美元。該公司表示，這些承諾主要與記憶體有關，其中920億美元預計在2027會計年度剩餘期間支付，870億美元將於2028會計年度支付，另有880億美元安排在2029會計年度支付。
對記憶體製造商而言，這代表未來數年的需求能見度明顯提高。
目前市場主要由美光科技(MU-US) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 與三星電子(005930KS) 三大業者主導。
SK海力士已與約10家客戶簽訂長期協議；美光則表示，16份策略客戶協議涵蓋合約期間約20%的DRAM產能及約三分之一的NAND產能；三星也已與主要客戶達成多年期記憶體供應協議。
長約有助於記憶體業者降低需求的不確定性，但這並不代表記憶體產業已徹底擺脫景氣循環。

記憶體仍逃不過價格循環　供給增加可能再度反轉

記憶體營收高度受到價格影響，這也是投資人不能忽略的風險。
2018年，記憶體占整體半導體營收比重一度達約34%，但隔年記憶體營收便大減31.5%，其中DRAM平均售價（ASP）暴跌47.4%，記憶體占半導體產業的比重也降至26.7%。
Gartner當時將市場崩跌歸因於產能過剩及價格下滑。這代表記憶體市場即使實際需求沒有大幅萎縮，只要供給增加導致價格下跌，產業營收與獲利仍可能迅速受到衝擊。
長期供應協議確實能鎖定部分採購量，有些合約也包含價格安排，但並不能完全隔絕標準DRAM與NAND受到新產能、庫存及價格競爭的影響。
另一方面，產能擴張也正在進行。SK海力士計畫投資40億美元，在美國印第安納州興建下一代HBM封裝廠；同時，公司已核准截至2031年合計54.3兆韓元（約383億美元）的投資計畫。
技術發展則是另一項變數。SK海力士與SanDisk已推出高頻寬快閃記憶體（High Bandwidth Flash，HBF）標準，目標是緩解AI運算所面臨的記憶體瓶頸。
若相關架構進一步發展，也可能讓部分原本高度依賴HBM的AI工作負載轉向快閃記憶體。

手機記憶體成本暴增　甚至超越旗艦SoC

AI需求同樣正在影響消費電子產品的記憶體成本。
根據微博爆料帳號「數碼閒聊站」的估計，DRAM與NAND的組合成本近期大幅上升，漲幅達340%，甚至已超過部分頂級SoC的價格。
該帳號指出，去年手機廠商採用12GB RAM搭配256GB NAND時，相關成本約70美元；到了2026年第3季，同樣的12GB＋256GB組合，成本已升至約310美元。
相較之下，頂級手機SoC目前價格約280美元。也就是說，記憶體與儲存裝置的成本已成為手機物料清單中極為昂貴的項目。
若手機廠商進一步採用16GB＋256GB或16GB＋512GB等更高容量配置，成本壓力還會進一步增加，可能迫使業者調整產品定價與規格。
「數碼閒聊站」也指出，頂級SoC雖然同樣面臨價格上漲，但漲幅仍低於記憶體與儲存產品，因此SoC已退居手機最昂貴零組件的第二位。

AI讓記憶體景氣週期變長　但沒有消失

從產業結構來看，AI確實正在改變記憶體市場的運作方式。HBM的高需求，加上大型科技公司提前多年簽訂供應協議，使記憶體業者獲得過去較少見的訂單能見度。
但這並不代表記憶體已永久脫離週期性。
Gartner最新預測顯示，2026年記憶體營收占整體半導體市場比重將達54%，遠高於2025年的約27%。這項變化也強化了市場對美光、SK海力士及三星等主要記憶體業者的樂觀看法。
然而，隨著新產能逐步開出，加上HBM以外的新技術可能出現替代方案，當供給最終追上甚至超越需求時，記憶體價格仍可能重新面臨壓力。
因此，AI更可能是延長並放大記憶體景氣循環，而非徹底消滅週期。目前由AI需求推升的8373億美元記憶體市場，未來仍必須面對供給擴張後可能出現的新一輪供需平衡。
paras_en: The AI wave is reshaping the supply‑and‑demand structure of the semiconductor industry. The memory market, which historically depended heavily on economic cycles and experienced volatile pricing, is now being transformed by a surge in high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) demand and large cloud providers locking in capacity years in advance, turning it from a traditional commodity semiconductor into a core component of AI infrastructure.
In April, Gartner projected global memory revenue would climb from $216.3 billion in 2025 to $633.3 billion in 2026, representing about 48% of the total $1.32 trillion semiconductor market.
By August, Gartner further revised its outlook, estimating 2026 memory revenue would reach $837.3 billion, pushing its share of the $1.56 trillion semiconductor market up to 54%.
In other words, memory’s role within the semiconductor industry has risen dramatically, with AI‑driven HBM demand serving as a key driver of this market re‑valuation.

AI demand explosion – tech giants lock in memory years ahead
The impact of AI on memory demand is reflected not only in market forecasts but also directly in chip makers’ procurement behavior.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US) increased its quarterly supply‑chain and capacity pre‑payment commitments from $119 billion to $279 billion. The company said these commitments are largely memory‑related, with $92 billion slated for payment during the remainder of fiscal 2027, $87 billion in fiscal 2028, and another $88 billion scheduled for fiscal 2029.
For memory manufacturers, this translates into markedly higher visibility of demand over the coming years.
The market is currently dominated by three major players: Micron Technology (MU‑US), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS).

SK Hynix has signed long‑term agreements with roughly ten customers; Micron said its 16 strategic customer agreements cover about 20% of its DRAM capacity and roughly one‑third of its NAND capacity; Samsung has also reached multi‑year memory supply agreements with its key customers.
Long‑term contracts help memory makers reduce demand uncertainty, but they do not mean the memory industry has completely escaped cyclical dynamics.

Memory still cannot avoid price cycles – increased supply could trigger another reversal
Memory revenue is highly price‑sensitive, a risk investors cannot ignore.

In 2018, memory accounted for about 34% of total semiconductor revenue, but the following year memory revenue fell 31.5%, with DRAM average selling price (ASP) plunging 47.4%, and memory’s share of the semiconductor industry dropping to 26.7%.

Gartner at the time attributed the market crash to excess capacity and falling prices. This shows that even if actual demand does not shrink dramatically, a supply increase that drives prices down can quickly hurt industry revenue and profitability.

Long‑term supply agreements can lock in part of the purchase volume, and some contracts include price terms, but they cannot fully shield standard DRAM and NAND from the effects of new capacity, inventory builds, and price competition.

On the other hand, capacity expansion is already underway. SK Hynix plans to invest $4 billion to build a next‑generation HBM packaging plant in Indiana, USA; the company has also approved investment projects totaling 54.3 trillion won (about $38.3 billion) through 2031.
Technology development is another variable. SK Hynix and SanDisk have introduced a High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) standard, aiming to alleviate the memory bottleneck faced by AI workloads.
If the related architecture matures further, it could shift some AI workloads that currently rely heavily on HBM toward flash memory.

Mobile memory costs soar – even surpassing flagship SoCs
AI demand is also affecting memory costs in consumer electronics.
According to estimates from the Weibo account “Digital Chat Station,” the combined cost of DRAM and NAND has risen sharply, up 340%, and has even exceeded the price of some top‑end SoCs.
The account noted that last year, when a phone maker used a 12 GB RAM plus 256 GB NAND configuration, the associated cost was about $70; by Q3 2026, the same 12 GB + 256 GB combo cost roughly $310.
In comparison, a top‑end mobile SoC currently sells for about $280. In other words, memory and storage have become extremely expensive items on a phone’s bill of materials.

If phone makers move to higher‑capacity configurations such as 16 GB + 256 GB or 16 GB + 512 GB, cost pressure will rise further, potentially forcing them to adjust product pricing and specifications.

Digital Chat Station also pointed out that while top‑end SoCs are also seeing price increases, the rise is still lower than that of memory and storage products, pushing the SoC to the second‑most expensive component in a phone.

AI lengthens the memory business cycle but does not eliminate it
From an industry‑structure perspective, AI is indeed changing how the memory market operates. The high demand for HBM, combined with large tech companies signing supply agreements years in advance, gives memory makers order visibility that was rarely seen before.
However, this does not mean memory has permanently escaped its cyclical nature.

Gartner’s latest forecast shows memory revenue will account for 54% of the overall semiconductor market in 2026, far above the roughly 27% share in 2025. This shift reinforces a bullish outlook for major memory players such as Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung.
Nevertheless, as new capacity comes online and alternative technologies beyond HBM emerge, once supply eventually catches up with or exceeds demand, memory prices could again come under pressure.

Thus, AI is more likely to extend and amplify the memory business cycle rather than eradicate it entirely. The $837.3 billion memory market driven by AI demand will still have to confront a new supply‑demand balance once capacity expands.

items.title: 貝森特警告中國1.2兆美元貿易順差「難以持續」！籲G20聯手逼北京轉向內需
items.title_en: Bessent Warns China’s $1.2 Trillion Trade Surplus Is Unsustainable, Urges G20 to Push Beijing Toward Domestic Demand
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週日（30日）表示，他將敦促G20成員重新檢視與中國的貿易條件，以縮小全球經濟失衡，並促使北京調整經濟結構，降低對出口的依賴、轉向國內消費。
根據《路透》報導，貝森特在G20財長會議召開前接受訪問時表示，儘管美國與中國的直接貿易關係正在「快速改善」，但目前中國商品大量出口至全球市場的情況難以持續。
貝森特說：「全球無法承受一個擁有1.2兆美元貿易順差的中國。中國目前的經濟相當疲弱，他們正試圖透過出口來擺脫困境，需要調整經濟結構。」
貝森特推動各國協調應對中國貿易問題之際，美國正因法律上的挫折而被迫重新調整關稅政策。這些關稅措施大幅降低美國自中國進口的商品，但也導致中國商品大量轉向其他市場，尤其是歐洲與拉丁美洲。
美國已透過高額關稅以及全面禁止部分產品進口（包括汽車）等措施，將許多中國商品擋在美國市場之外。貝森特表示，他去年曾告訴其他工業化經濟體，中國進口商品激增將對它們造成壓力，而「現在他們正面臨一些非常嚴峻的選擇」。
貝森特說：「全球其他國家將不得不重新檢視與中國的貿易條件。」他表示，其他國家必須設法給予中國誘因，促使其降低對出口的依賴，並強化長期疲弱的國內需求。
美國正推動G20發布聯合聲明，呼籲降低貿易與經常帳失衡。
根據美國人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）數據，自美國總統川普2025年重返白宮後實施的關稅措施，已使2026年前6個月美國對中國的貿易逆差較2025年同期縮減三分之一，降至739億美元。
基於進口商試圖趕在預期中的關稅措施生效前提前進貨，2025年同期1月部分中國商品進口曾加速。
儘管部分經濟學家及歐洲領袖主張透過協調行動推動人民幣升值，貝森特則質疑此舉的成效。國際貨幣基金（IMF）評估，人民幣可能被低估最多21%。
貝森特表示，認為重新達成一項新的「廣場協議」（Plaza Accord）就能解決經濟失衡的看法並不恰當。1985年的廣場協議旨在透過協調政策促使各國貨幣兌美元升值。
他認為，這只是一種「迴避處理真正貿易問題的簡單方法」，而真正的問題在於中國過度的工業補貼，以及疲弱的國內需求。

下一次美中峰會

貝森特表示，目前尚不清楚他是否會在川普與中國國家主席習近平預計於9月底在白宮舉行會談前，與中國對口官員、中國國務院副總理何立峰親自會面。
貝森特表示，在峰會舉行前，美中官員將繼續就可能降低非戰略性商品關稅，以及人工智慧（AI）安全防護措施展開對話，避免功能強大的AI模型落入非國家行為者手中。
貝森特說：「我認為，雙方可能各自都有價值約300億美元的非戰略性、非關鍵商品，可以取消關稅。」
此次9月峰會正值美國重新調整川普關稅政策之際。美國最高法院先前推翻依據緊急狀態法實施的廣泛關稅措施，其中包括對中國進口商品課徵20%關稅，因此美國目前正重新建立相關關稅政策。
川普政府7月則在一項反強迫勞動貿易調查下，對中國進口商品加徵12.5%關稅；此外，美方也可能在另一項針對產能過剩的調查下，進一步加徵關稅。
貝森特另表示，他計畫在阿什維爾（Asheville）舉行的G20會議期間，與中國人民銀行行長潘功勝舉行雙邊會談，但拒絕透露相關細節。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Sunday (the 30th) said he would urge G20 members to re‑examine trade terms with China to reduce global economic imbalances and push Beijing to adjust its economic structure, reduce reliance on exports, and shift toward domestic consumption.

According to Reuters, Bessent said in an interview before the G20 finance ministers’ meeting that although U.S.–China direct trade relations are "rapidly improving," the current situation of China exporting large volumes of goods to global markets is unsustainable.

Bessent said, "The world cannot bear a China with a $1.2 trillion trade surplus. China’s economy is currently very weak, and they are trying to escape the crisis through exports; they need to adjust their economic structure."

While Bessent pushes for coordinated responses to China’s trade issues, the U.S. is forced to readjust tariff policy due to legal setbacks. These tariff measures have sharply reduced U.S. imports from China but have also caused Chinese goods to shift to other markets, especially Europe and Latin America.

The U.S. has blocked many Chinese goods from the U.S. market through high tariffs and a comprehensive ban on certain products (including automobiles). Bessent said he told other industrialized economies last year that a surge in Chinese imports would pressure them, and "now they face some very tough choices."

Bessent said, "Other countries worldwide will have to re‑examine trade terms with China." He added that other countries must find ways to give China incentives to reduce export reliance and strengthen long‑term weak domestic demand.
The U.S. is pushing the G20 to issue a joint statement calling for a reduction in trade and current‑account imbalances.

According to U.S. Census Bureau data, since President Trump’s return to the White House in 2025 and the implementation of tariff measures, the U.S. trade deficit with China in the first six months of 2026 has shrunk by one‑third compared with the same period in 2025, down to $73.9 billion.
Because importers tried to stock up before the expected tariff measures took effect, some Chinese goods saw accelerated imports in January of the same period in 2025.

Although some economists and European leaders advocate coordinated action to push the renminbi higher, Bessent questioned its effectiveness. The IMF assessed that the renminbi could be undervalued by up to 21%.
Bessent said that the view that a new "Plaza Accord" could solve the imbalance is inappropriate. The 1985 Plaza Accord aimed to coordinate policies to appreciate currencies against the dollar.
He argued that this is merely a "simple way to avoid dealing with real trade problems," and the real issue lies in China’s excessive industrial subsidies and weak domestic demand.

Next U.S.–China summit
Bessent said it is still unclear whether he will meet with China’s counterpart officials, including Vice Premier He Lifeng, before the meeting between Trump and President Xi Jinping scheduled for the end of September at the White House.

Bessent said that before the summit, U.S. and Chinese officials will continue to discuss possible reductions in non‑strategic goods tariffs and AI safety measures to prevent powerful AI models from falling into the hands of non‑state actors.
Bessent said, "I think both sides may each have about $30 billion worth of non‑strategic, non‑critical goods that could have tariffs lifted."

The September summit comes as the U.S. readjusts Trump’s tariff policy. The Supreme Court previously overturned broad tariff measures implemented under the emergency‑status law, including a 20% tariff on Chinese imports, so the U.S. is currently rebuilding related tariff policy.

In July, the Trump administration imposed a 12.5% tariff on Chinese imports under a forced‑labour trade investigation; additionally, the U.S. may impose further tariffs under another investigation targeting overcapacity.
Bessent also said he plans to hold a bilateral meeting with Bank of China Governor Pan Gongsheng during the G20 meeting in Asheville, but declined to disclose details.

items.title: 看多美債40年也變心 「債市多頭總司令」大砍長債轉抱現金
items.title_en: Bullish on 40‑Year U.S. Treasuries Turns to Bearish: The 'Chief Bull of the Bond Market' Cuts Long Bonds for Cash
paras: 有「華爾街債市多頭總司令」之稱的萊西．亨特（Lacy Hunt），在連續看多美債40年後，近期開始轉為看空長期美債。這項轉變不只停留在言論層面，他任職的Hoisington Investment Management已將客戶投資組合的債券有效存續期，從2025年9月約21年大幅降至2026年6月的不到1年，幾乎把所有長期債券部位轉為現金。
亨特認為，1990年至2020年間支撐全球債券多頭行情的「全球化通縮紅利」已出現結構性逆轉。去全球化、人口結構改變、資本日益稀缺，以及超大規模財政赤字等因素疊加，可能使美國長期通膨中樞從過去的1.5%至3.5%，上移至3.5%至4.5%，甚至不排除單季突破5%。
身為債市最具影響力的傳統多頭之一，亨特的轉向被視為核心投資邏輯遭到顛覆，也意味全球經濟可能已進入與過去40年截然不同的長期利率及通膨環境。
全球化紅利逐步消退
亨特指出，過去30年全球通膨受到壓抑，關鍵在於全球化帶來的生產要素重新配置。大量低成本勞動力進入全球供應體系，跨國企業將生產外包至成本較低的國家，持續壓低已開發國家的消費品價格。
如今，全球貿易模式正從「成本優先」轉向「安全與韌性優先」。後疫情時代的供應鏈重建、中美地緣政治競爭、關稅壁壘，以及產業回流與友岸外包政策，使生產、物流和庫存管理成本出現結構性上升。
即使2025年全球商品貿易占全球GDP比重升至68.5%，創1979年以來新高，跨境生產分工仍逐漸被區域內的短供應鏈取代。
缺工與資本稀缺推升成本
人口結構逆轉同樣加劇通膨壓力。美國勞動年齡人口增速放緩、嬰兒潮世代陸續退休，加上移民政策收緊，使經濟從勞動力充裕轉為持續缺工。醫療、建築、旅館及教育等難以外包或快速自動化的服務業，薪資上漲更容易轉嫁至終端價格，形成薪資與物價相互推升的循環。
另一方面，過去壓低利率的「全球儲蓄過剩」也逐漸被資本稀缺取代。美國國民淨儲蓄率已從長期平均占國民收入約6.8%，降至歷史低檔，但AI基礎設施、電網現代化、半導體產能在地化及國防製造升級，均需要龐大投資。在儲蓄不足、資金需求旺盛之下，長期實質利率面臨持續上升壓力。
赤字與利息形成惡性循環
亨特並引述史學家尼爾．弗格森的研究指出，當投資人開始擔憂政府債務的可持續性，便會要求更高的風險溢價，推升長期公債殖利率；殖利率上升又會增加政府利息支出、擴大赤字，進一步強化市場的通膨預期。
2024年，美國債務利息支出首次超過軍事支出，2026財年更突破1兆美元，高於國防預算。隨著債務持續增加，市場必須吸收更多新增公債供給，長期殖利率也將承受上行壓力。
Hoisington已把債券投資組合的有效存續期，從20.88年的高點降至不到1年。亨特直言，通膨已成為長期趨勢，而非暫時波動；在新的總體環境下，黃金的保值能力可能優於長期美債。
截至2026年8月，美國10年期公債殖利率已升破4.5%，30年期殖利率則逼近5%，顯示延續40年的低通膨、低利率時代正面臨根本性改變。
paras_en: Lacy Hunt, known as the "Chief Bull of the Wall Street Bond Market," has shifted from a 40‑year bullish stance on U.S. Treasuries to a bearish view on long‑term bonds. This change is not just verbal; his firm, Hoisington Investment Management, has reduced the effective duration of client bond portfolios from about 21 years in September 2025 to less than one year in June 2026, almost converting all long‑term bond positions into cash.

Hunt argues that the "globalization deflationary dividend" that supported a global bond bull market from 1990 to 2020 has undergone a structural reversal. De‑globalization, demographic shifts, increasing capital scarcity, and massive fiscal deficits may push the U.S. long‑term inflation anchor from the past 1.5%–3.5% range to 3.5%–4.5%, and even a single‑quarter break above 5% cannot be ruled out.

As one of the most influential traditional bulls in the bond market, Hunt’s reversal is seen as a core investment logic upheaval, implying that the global economy may have entered a long‑term interest rate and inflation environment starkly different from the past 40 years.
The globalization dividend is gradually fading.

Hunt points out that for the past 30 years, global inflation has been suppressed largely due to the reallocation of production factors brought about by globalization. Large amounts of low‑cost labor entered global supply chains, and multinational corporations outsourced production to lower‑cost countries, continuously driving down consumer prices in developed nations.

Today, global trade patterns are shifting from a "cost‑first" to a "safety and resilience‑first" approach. Post‑pandemic supply‑chain reconstruction, U.S.–China geopolitical competition, tariff barriers, and policies promoting reshoring and friend‑shore outsourcing have structurally increased production, logistics, and inventory‑management costs.

Even though global commodity trade as a share of global GDP rises to 68.5% in 2025—its highest level since 1979—cross‑border production division is gradually being replaced by regional short supply chains.
Labor shortages and capital scarcity drive up costs.

The reversal in demographic structure also intensifies inflationary pressure. The U.S. labor‑age population growth slows, the baby‑boomer generation retires, and tightened immigration policy turns the economy from labor‑abundant to persistently labor‑short. In service sectors such as healthcare, construction, hospitality, and education—hard to outsource or automate—wage increases more readily translate into end‑price hikes, creating a wage‑price spiral.

On the other hand, the "global savings glut" that previously suppressed rates is gradually being replaced by capital scarcity. U.S. national net savings has fallen from a long‑term average of about 6.8% of national income to historic lows, while AI infrastructure, grid modernization, semiconductor capacity localization, and defense manufacturing upgrades all require massive investment. With insufficient savings and high capital demand, long‑term real rates face sustained upward pressure.
Deficits and interest create a vicious cycle.

Hunt cites historian Neil Ferguson’s research, noting that when investors worry about government debt sustainability, they demand higher risk premiums, pushing up long‑term Treasury yields; higher yields increase government interest expenses, expand deficits, and further strengthen inflation expectations in the market.

In 2024, U.S. debt interest payments exceeded military spending for the first time, and the 2026 fiscal year is projected to surpass $1 trillion, higher than the defense budget. As debt continues to rise, the market must absorb more new Treasury supply, and long‑term yields will face upward pressure.

Hoisington has reduced the effective duration of its bond portfolio from a peak of 20.88 years to less than one year. Hunt bluntly states that inflation has become a long‑term trend rather than a temporary fluctuation; in the new overall environment, gold’s store‑of‑value ability may outperform long‑term U.S. Treasuries.

By August 2026, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield has risen above 4.5%, and the 30‑year yield is approaching 5%, indicating that the 40‑year era of low inflation and low rates is facing a fundamental change.

items.title: 美國擬「每週」對伊朗祭新制裁！貝森特警告：銀行成首波目標
items.title_en: US Plans Weekly New Sanctions on Iran! Bessent Warns: Banks the First Target
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週日（30日）表示，美國財政部可能每週公布新的次級制裁措施，以加大對伊朗的經濟壓力，初期將鎖定銀行。
根據《路透》報導，在美國週五（28日）以涉嫌與伊朗存在金融關聯為由，對在阿拉伯聯合大公國的埃及國營銀行Banque Misr分行實施制裁後，貝森特表示，下一步可能是將相關金融機構徹底排除在以美元為基礎的金融體系之外。
貝森特在G20財長與央行總裁會議召開前表示：「未來你們每週都會看到更多這類措施。我們將從銀行開始，並告訴銀行，持有伊朗資金以及協助伊朗政權都是不可接受的。」
貝森特表示，他打算向G20財長及央行總裁強調這項訊息，要求各國切斷與伊朗的經濟聯繫，否則就可能面臨次級制裁。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday (the 30th) that the Treasury may announce new secondary sanctions each week to increase economic pressure on Iran, initially focusing on banks.

According to Reuters, after the United States imposed sanctions on a branch of Egypt’s state‑owned Banque Misr in the United Arab Emirates on Friday (the 28th for alleged financial links to Iran, Bessent said the next step could be to fully exclude the relevant financial institutions from the dollar‑based financial system.

Speaking ahead of the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting, Bessent said, "In the future you will see more of these measures every week. We will start with banks and tell them that holding Iranian funds and assisting the Iranian regime is unacceptable."
Bessent said he intends to stress this message to the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors, urging countries to cut economic ties with Iran or face possible secondary sanctions.

items.title: SK海力士擬赴日本合資設記憶體晶片廠！南韓5.4兆韓元擴產同步推進
items.title_en: SK Hynix Plans Joint Venture in Japan to Build Memory Chip Factory! South Korea Invests 5.4 Trillion KRW in Expansion
paras: 人工智慧（AI）熱潮持續推升記憶體需求，南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士(000660KS) 正評估在日本成立合資企業、興建記憶體晶片廠的可行性，作為擴充產能、滿足AI市場需求並控制生產成本的選項之一。
根據《彭博》報導，SK集團董事長崔泰源（Chey Tae-won）日前在日本仙台出席韓日商會相關會議期間表示，公司正評估多個地點，作為共同營運工廠的可能選址。
崔泰源接受《彭博新聞》採訪時表示：「我們正在日本各地尋找。」他指出，任何「電力和水資源充足」的地方都可以考慮。
當被問及這類合資事業可能的合作夥伴或日本境內的具體地點時，崔泰源拒絕進一步說明。SK集團旗下事業版圖涵蓋能源、電信及晶片等多個領域，集團層級會負責主要投資的資本配置。
AI熱潮已讓位於南韓利川（Icheon）的SK海力士成為崔泰源旗下SK集團最重要的核心事業之一。
該公司的產品協助輝達(NVDA-US) 及資料中心業者進行AI運算。SK海力士上週已為位於美國印第安納州的晶片封裝廠舉行動工儀式，目前也正進一步探索海外擴張的可能性。
SK海力士正全球尋找可能的晶片生產基地，以因應AI帶動的龐大資料儲存需求，同時也必須應對美國遏制中國科技發展野心的相關措施。
該公司計畫在南韓投入5.4兆韓元（約390億美元）擴建晶片製造設施，並在美國印第安納州西拉法葉（West Lafayette）興建先進記憶體封裝廠。
SK海力士尋找日本生產據點，是公司整體深化與日本客戶及供應商合作計畫的一環。該公司目前已間接持有總部位於東京的快閃記憶體製造商鎧俠（Kioxia）相當規模的股權。
SK海力士執行長Kwak Noh-Jung上週表示，公司正「審慎評估如何與客戶及供應商共同開發NAND快閃記憶體市場」。
除了高頻寬記憶體（HBM）之外，NAND的需求也大幅增加。Meta(META-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 等投入巨資的企業，正競相取得規模越來越大的資料儲存容量，同時追求比傳統硬碟更快的效能。
SK海力士的競爭對手美光科技(MU-US) 在日本西部廣島設有工廠。日本也聚集SK海力士廣泛的供應商，從未上市的Namics 到半導體設備大廠東京威力科創，以及包括索尼(SONY-US) 和任天堂在內的眾多客戶。
日本政府也已展現大力補貼國際晶片製造商在當地擴充產能的意願，包括台積電(2330-TW) 等企業。
身兼大韓商工會議所會長的崔泰源，在韓、日兩國商會會長年度會議召開前，出席一場聚焦兩國勞動力縮減問題的活動時表示：「現在正是韓國與日本組成經濟聯盟的時候。」
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: The AI boom continues to drive memory demand, and South Korean memory giant SK Hynix (000660KS) is evaluating the feasibility of setting up a joint venture in Japan to build a memory chip plant as one option to expand capacity, meet AI market demand, and control production costs.

According to Bloomberg, SK Group chairman Chey Tae-won recently stated at a Korean‑Japanese Chamber of Commerce meeting in Sendai, Japan, that the company is assessing several sites as potential locations for a jointly operated factory.
Chey told Bloomberg News, “We’re looking across Japan.” He added that any location with ample power and water resources could be considered.

When asked about potential partners or specific sites in Japan, Chey declined to elaborate. SK Group’s business portfolio spans energy, telecom, and chips, and the group level will handle capital allocation for major investments.
The AI surge has positioned SK Hynix in Icheon, South Korea, as one of Chey’s most important core businesses.

The company’s products help NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and data‑center operators run AI workloads. SK Hynix held a groundbreaking ceremony last week for a chip‑packaging plant in Indiana, USA, and is also exploring overseas expansion opportunities.

SK Hynix is searching globally for potential chip‑manufacturing sites to meet the massive data‑storage demand driven by AI, while also addressing U.S. measures aimed at curbing China’s tech ambitions.

The company plans to invest 5.4 trillion KRW (about US$390 million) in expanding chip‑manufacturing facilities in South Korea and to build an advanced memory‑packaging plant in West Lafayette, Indiana, USA.

SK Hynix’s search for a Japanese production site is part of its broader strategy to deepen collaboration with Japanese customers and suppliers. The company already indirectly holds a substantial stake in Tokyo‑based flash memory maker Kioxia.
SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh‑Jung said last week that the company is “carefully evaluating how to co‑develop the NAND flash market with customers and suppliers.”

In addition to high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), demand for NAND has surged. Companies such as Meta (META‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) are investing heavily to secure ever‑larger storage capacities while pursuing performance faster than traditional hard drives.

SK Hynix’s competitor Micron Technology (MU‑US) operates a plant in western Japan’s Hiroshima. Japan also hosts a wide range of SK Hynix suppliers, from the unlisted Namics to semiconductor equipment giant Tokyo Vigor, and many customers including Sony (SONY‑US) and Nintendo.
The Japanese government has also shown strong willingness to subsidize international chip manufacturers expanding capacity locally, including companies such as TSMC (2330‑TW).

Chey, who also serves as president of the Korean Chamber of Commerce and Industry, said at an event focused on labor‑force reductions in Korea and Japan before the annual presidents’ meeting that “now is the time for Korea and Japan to form an economic alliance.”

items.title: Google Maps將安大略湖標注為「美國湖」
items.title_en: Google Maps Labels Lake Ontario as "American Lake"
paras: 美國總統川普30日（周日）在社交媒體平台發布一張地圖，顯示地處美國與加拿大邊境的安大略湖，如今已被標注為「美國湖」。
Google在一份聲明中說，Google Maps已為美國用戶將安大略湖名稱更改為「美國湖」，以「反映川普日前簽署的湖泊更名行政命令」。
美國總統的行政命令影響的是美國地理名稱訊息系統，該系統為美國官方地圖設定標準。它對加拿大的命名慣例或世界其他地區對該湖泊的稱呼沒有任何影響。
去年Google Maps對墨西哥灣也做出了類似更改：在川普就職後簽署行政命令將該水域更名為「美國灣」後，Google Maps便將墨西哥灣標注為「美國灣」。
paras_en: President Trump posted a map on social media on Sunday, the 30th, showing Lake Ontario—located on the U.S.-Canada border—now labeled as "American Lake".
Google said in a statement that Google Maps has renamed Lake Ontario to "American Lake" for U.S. users to "reflect the renaming executive order Trump signed recently."

Trump’s executive order affects the U.S. Geographic Names Information System, which sets standards for official U.S. maps. It has no impact on Canada’s naming conventions or how the lake is referred to elsewhere in the world.

Last year, Google Maps made a similar change to the Gulf of Mexico: after Trump signed an executive order renaming the body of water "American Gulf," Google Maps labeled the Gulf of Mexico as "American Gulf."

items.title: AI資料中心拉貨升溫三星電機、LG Innotek封裝載板稼動率逼近滿載
items.title_en: AI Data Center Demand Drives Samsung Electro-Mechanics and LG Innotek Packaging Board Utilization Near Full Capacity
paras: 2026年08月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器與客製化AI晶片需求快速增加，高階半導體封裝載板供應轉趨吃緊。2026年上半年，三星電機Samsung Electro-Mechanics(009150-KR)封裝載板產線稼動率由去年同期69.8%升至89%；LG Innotek(011070-KR)則由80.8%提高至94%，兩家公司同步加快擴產。
營收也反映需求升溫。三星電機上半年封裝解決方案營收達1兆4,966億韓元，年增40.7%；LG Innotek封裝載板營收達9,356億韓元，年增18%。

兩大韓廠同步赴越南擴產新產能2028年開出
三星電機規劃在越南投資12億美元，擴充半導體封裝載板產能，新產能預計2028年投入生產，公司並已取得數家美國客製化AI晶片業者的載板訂單。
LG Innotek則投資10億美元，在越南海防興建公司首座位於韓國以外的半導體製造基地，預計2028年第3季量產。新廠初期以RF-SiP、FC-CSP等封裝載板為主；AI伺服器所需的高階FC-BGA載板則優先由韓國龜尾廠生產，目標2027年擴大出貨。
目前全球主要科技客戶對記憶體與AI封裝載板的需求滿足率僅約60%至70%，供應短缺預估可能延續至2028年。

paras_en: In late August 2026, the rapid rise in demand for AI servers and custom AI chips has tightened supply of high‑end semiconductor packaging boards. In the first half of 2026, Samsung Electro‑Mechanics (009150‑KR) raised its packaging board line utilization from 69.8% to 89% year‑on‑year, while LG Innotek (011070‑KR) increased from 80.8% to 94%, prompting both companies to accelerate expansion.

Revenue also reflects the heating demand. Samsung Electro‑Mechanics’ packaging solutions revenue reached 1.4966 trillion Korean won in the first half, up 40.7% YoY, while LG Innotek’s packaging board revenue hit 935.6 billion won, up 18%.

Both major Korean firms are expanding capacity in Vietnam, with plans to launch new production lines by 2028. Samsung Electro‑Mechanics plans a US$1.2 billion investment in Vietnam to expand semiconductor packaging board capacity, with the new capacity slated for production in 2028; the company has already secured orders from several U.S. custom AI chip makers.

LG Innotek is investing US$1 billion to build its first semiconductor manufacturing base outside Korea in Haiphong, Vietnam, targeting volume production in Q3 2028. The new plant will initially focus on RF‑SiP and FC‑CSP packaging boards, while high‑end FC‑BGA boards needed for AI servers will continue to be produced at the Korean Gyeonggi plant, with a goal to scale shipments by 2027.
Globally, the fulfillment rate for memory and AI packaging board demand among major tech customers is only about 60% to 70%, and supply shortages are expected to persist through 2028.

items.title: 美軍攻擊伊朗拉拉克島 伊朗報復襲擊駐約旦美軍基地
items.title_en: US Military Strikes Iran’s Larak Island; Iran Retaliates Against US Base in Jordan
paras: 一名美國官員表示，美軍周日（30日）打擊了伊朗拉拉克島上兩具發射裝置，這是自7月下旬以來已知的美軍首次對伊朗境內目標發動打擊。
「我可以確認，今天（30日）早些時候，美軍打擊了拉拉克島上兩具伊朗發射裝置。根據觀察，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊當時正準備向荷姆茲海峽發射搭載水雷的火箭彈。」這名美國官員說。
據伊朗國家媒體報導，伊朗革命衛隊稱此次襲擊造成多名士兵和平民死傷，德黑蘭將對此予以「反擊和懲罰」。
伊朗半官方塔斯尼姆通訊社稱，美國對拉拉克島發動無人機打擊。
美國總統川普日前表示，荷姆茲海峽國際水域所有水雷均已被引爆或清除，而且美方已告知伊朗，任何布設新水雷的船隻都會被摧毀。
另外，《Fox News》記者Trey Yingst周日援引一位美國消息人士的話，稱伊朗正在襲擊駐扎在約旦的美軍部隊。
Yingst在X平台發文，稱截至目前未造成重大影響，並稱幾乎所有飛彈「均被攔截」。
據伊朗媒體報導，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊周一表示，已使用彈道飛彈襲擊了約旦境內King Hussein和Al Azraq美軍基地，以回應美國對拉拉克島的襲擊。
paras_en: A U.S. official said that on Sunday (the 30th) the U.S. military hit two launch devices on Iran’s Larak Island, marking the first known U.S. strike against a target inside Iran since late July.

“I can confirm that earlier today (the 30th) the U.S. military struck two Iranian launch devices on Larak Island. Observers noted that Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps was preparing to fire rocket‑propelled mines into the Hormuz Strait at that time,” the official said.

Iranian state media reported that the Revolutionary Guard said the attack caused multiple soldiers and civilians to be killed or wounded, and Tehran will respond with “counter‑measures and punishment.”
The semi‑official Iranian news agency Tasnim said the United States carried out a drone strike on Larak Island.

President Trump recently stated that all mines in the international waters of the Hormuz Strait have been detonated or cleared, and the U.S. has warned Iran that any vessel laying new mines will be destroyed.
In addition, Fox News reporter Trey Yingst quoted a U.S. source on Sunday saying Iran was attacking U.S. forces stationed in Jordan.
Yingst posted on X that, so far, the attacks have not caused major effects and said almost all missiles “were intercepted.”

Iranian media reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Monday it had used ballistic missiles to strike the U.S. bases at King Hussein and Al‑Azraq in Jordan in retaliation for the U.S. strike on Larak Island.

items.title: 彭博：蘋果內部測試過折疊iPhone觸控筆
items.title_en: Bloomberg: Apple Internally Tested Foldable iPhone Pencil
paras: 在蘋果(AAPL-US) 9月新品發表會登場前，據《彭博》30日（周日）報導，蘋果在內部對適用於折疊iPhone的 觸控筆Apple Pencil進行過原型製作、測試，並考慮過推出這款產品。
但目前來看，Apple Pencil不太可能與新機同步上市。
蘋果測試的觸控筆原型比iPad所用版本更短，以適應手機獨特機身尺寸，並可透過磁吸方式固定在手機側面，同時實現收納和充電。
不過，折疊螢幕設計給觸控筆的使用帶來挑戰。觸控筆吸附在手機側面後，用戶展開設備時可能影響操作。
此外，折疊螢幕較脆弱，筆尖與螢幕接觸可能留下明顯痕跡。蘋果仍在權衡是否要推出這一配件。
蘋果共同創始人賈伯斯曾公開質疑手機觸控筆的必要性，此次內部測試可能意味著蘋果對這一產品形態的態度有所變化。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Before the Apple September 9 product launch, Bloomberg reported on Sunday the 30th that Apple had prototyped and tested an Apple Pencil designed for a foldable iPhone, and had considered launching the accessory.
However, the Apple Pencil is unlikely to debut alongside the new device.
The prototype pencil was shorter than the iPad version to fit the phone’s unique dimensions, and could be magnetically attached to the phone’s side for both storage and charging.
The foldable screen design poses challenges for the pencil’s use; once attached to the side, the pencil could interfere with the device when it is unfolded.
Additionally, the fragile foldable screen could show visible marks where the tip contacts the display, and Apple is still weighing whether to release the accessory.
Apple co‑founder Steve Jobs once publicly questioned the need for a phone stylus, so this internal testing may signal a shift in Apple’s stance on the product form factor.

items.title: 日元貶破160防線 當局隨時突襲干預、緊盯兩個關鍵價位
items.title_en: Yen Breaks 160 Barrier, Authorities Ready to Intervene at Key Levels
paras: 日元兌美元貶破160防線，凸顯出日元極易受到進一步走貶的衝擊，也大幅提高日本當局再次進場干預、阻貶匯率的風險。
儘管確切干預門檻仍不明朗，但多名策略師周一(31日)警告，可能促使當局出手阻止日元急貶的價位不少，最近的觀察點從161開始，其次是162至163區間。不過，他們仍認為，干預行動頂多只能爭取時間，因為日元已回吐7月底展開史上最大規模干預以來逾半數漲幅。
日元最新一波跌勢，主要受到美元上周五全面走強帶動，市場預期美國利率將維持在更高水準，也進一步印證日元走勢很大程度並非日本所能掌控。
日本7月進場干預後，日元未能升破155，隨後再度承壓。當時美國與日本聯手買進日元，是雙方自1998年以來首度採取協調干預行動。
三井住友日興證券資深利率與外匯策略師丸山倫斗表示：「就關鍵價位而言，首先要觀察161，其次是162.9至163.3區間，這是當局上次進場干預的位置。」不過，他指出，政府在前一次干預時「相當重視出其不意」，意味當局隨時都可能採取行動。
周一東京時間上午11點50分，日元兌美元匯率報159.77，較上周五紐約收盤價約160.09升值約0.2%。
根據日本財務省數據顯示，日本在過去一個月內砸下創紀錄的964億美元來支撐日元，此前日元曾崩跌至40年來的低點。財務大臣片山皐月與美國財政部長貝森特皆已暗示，必要時願意再次採取行動。
日本官員多次表明，評估是否有必要干預的關鍵在於匯率變動的速度與失序程度，而非任何特定的匯價水準。
貝森特也曾表示，他期望日本央行總裁植田和男能在貨幣政策上「做出正確的事」，同時形容近期日元的波動「相當受到控制」。
交換市場定價顯示，日本銀行在9月18日政策會議前升息的機率達90%，市場更已完全反映最晚10月30日前升息的預期。
澳洲國民銀行策略師Rodrigo Catril表示：「我們認為，美元兌日元升破162後，干預風險才會明顯升高。當美元全面走強，加上聯準會釋出鷹派訊號時，日本很難出手干預。」
投機性部位也再度轉向不利日元。避險基金在干預後一度大幅削減看空部位，如今又開始建立日元空單。自2025年7月以來，避險基金整體上一直對日元抱持負面看法。
澳洲聯邦銀行策略師Carol Kong表示：「如果日元快速貶值，我不認為日本當局一定要等到日本銀行開會後才再度干預。不過，由於市場已高度反映9月升息的可能性，當局或許會傾向先觀察貨幣政策能否發揮部分支撐日元的效果。」
市場人士指出，只要日本實質利率仍處於深度負值，單靠干預恐怕難以扭轉日元走勢。
華僑銀行策略師Moh Siong Sim認為，鑑於市場預期的升息幅度有限，日本央行正陷入更大的兩難。看來勢必得祭出鼓勵資金回流等其他政策工具，才能扭轉日元疲弱的頹勢。
paras_en: The yen fell below the 160 barrier against the dollar, highlighting its vulnerability to further depreciation and significantly raising the risk of Japanese authorities stepping in to curb the decline.

Although the exact intervention threshold remains unclear, several strategists warned on Monday (31st) that intervention could be triggered at several levels, starting at 161 and then the 162‑163 range. They still believe intervention would only buy time, as the yen has already reversed more than half of the gains since the largest intervention in history at the end of July.

The latest yen selloff was mainly driven by a comprehensive strengthening of the dollar last Friday, with markets expecting U.S. rates to remain higher, further confirming that the yen’s trajectory is largely beyond Japan’s control.

After Japan intervened in July, the yen failed to break above 155 and was subsequently pressured again. At that time, the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen, marking the first coordinated intervention since 1998.

Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities senior interest‑rate and FX strategist Tomoaki Maruyama said, "The key levels to watch are first 161, then the 162.9‑163.3 range, where the authorities last intervened." He added that the government placed great emphasis on surprise in the previous intervention, implying that action could be taken at any time.
At 11:50 a.m. Tokyo time on Monday, the yen was quoted at 159.77 against the dollar, about 0.2% stronger than the New York close on Friday at 160.09.

According to data from Japan’s Ministry of Finance, Japan spent a record 96.4 billion dollars in the past month to support the yen, after it had fallen to a 40‑year low. Finance Minister Hitoshi Katayama and U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen have both signaled willingness to act again if necessary.
Japanese officials have repeatedly stated that the key to deciding whether to intervene lies in the speed and disorder of the exchange‑rate movement, not any specific rate level.
Yellen also said she expects Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda to "do the right thing" in monetary policy, describing the recent yen volatility as "quite controlled."
Market pricing in the foreign‑exchange market shows a 90% probability of a rate hike at the BoJ policy meeting on September 18, with the market fully pricing in a hike by October 30 at the latest.

Australia’s National Australia Bank strategist Rodrigo Catril said, "We believe the risk of intervention rises significantly once the dollar rises above 162 against the yen. With the dollar strengthening and the Fed issuing hawkish signals, Japan would find it difficult to intervene."

Speculative positions have again turned against the yen. Hedge funds had previously cut short positions after intervention, but are now re‑building yen shorts. Since July 2025, hedge funds have generally maintained a negative view of the yen.

Australia’s Commonwealth Bank strategist Carol Kong said, "If the yen depreciates rapidly, I don’t think Japan will wait until the BoJ meeting to intervene again. However, since the market already reflects the likelihood of a September hike, authorities may prefer to observe whether monetary policy can provide some support for the yen."
Market participants note that as long as Japan’s real rates remain deeply negative, intervention alone is unlikely to reverse the yen’s trend.

China‑based Bank of China strategist Moh Siong Sim believes that given the limited expected rate hikes, the BoJ is in a deeper dilemma. It appears that other policy tools, such as encouraging capital inflows, will be needed to reverse the yen’s weak trajectory.

據財務省數據顯示，日本當局過去一個月斥資創紀錄的15.4兆日圓干預外匯市場以支撐日圓，規模顯現政府推動日圓擺脫四十年低位的決心，但美國密西根大學調查8月美國消費者對一年通貨膨脹預期降至4.0%，但消費者信心指數終值升至51.7高於預期及對五年期通膨脹預期維持3.3%，而且FED主席沃什在杰克森霍爾經濟研討會上發表演講表示，若決策者無法確信通貨膨脹率正回歸2%目標水平，那麼FED還有工作要做，並承認當前金融狀況未對經濟形成明顯限制，為迄今釋放最接近可能需要進一步升息的訊號，提振美元兌日圓至160.20高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於159.70-90，阻力於160.70-90。

Last week, initial US jobless claims fell for a second consecutive week to a one‑month low, but July's trade deficit hit a 16‑month high. At the Jackson Hole annual economic symposium, Federal Reserve officials expressed concerns about inflation, with many supporting another rate hike. Yet on Friday, before Fed Chair Jerome Powell’s speech at the symposium, the dollar was flat. Meanwhile, Japan reported a July job‑vacancy ratio of 1.18, unemployment fell to 2.4%, and August Tokyo CPI rose 1.8% year‑on‑year, above expectations, with core CPI (excluding food and energy) accelerating to 2.0%. Core inflation has risen for three straight months, strengthening the case for the Bank of Japan to raise rates as early as September. Prime Minister Kishida also said the government plans to cap new government bond issuance at about ¥40 trillion in the FY2027 budget, and Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki will attend the G20 finance ministers’ meeting on Tuesday, where markets will watch whether he meets US Treasury Secretary Yellen, supporting the dollar/yen hovering near the ¥159.28 low.

According to Ministry of Finance data, Japanese authorities intervened in the FX market with a record ¥15.4 trillion over the past month to support the yen, showing the government’s resolve to lift the yen from four‑decade lows. In the US, the University of Michigan’s August survey showed one‑year inflation expectations falling to 4.0%, while consumer confidence rose to 51.7, above forecasts, and five‑year inflation expectations held at 3.3%. Fed Chair Powell, speaking at Jackson Hole, warned that if policymakers are not convinced inflation is returning to the 2% target, the Fed still has work to do, acknowledging that current financial conditions have not yet imposed a clear drag on the economy. This was the clearest hint yet of possible further rate hikes, pushing the dollar/yen up to a ¥160.20 high. The dollar/yen is expected to find support around ¥159.70‑90 and face resistance near ¥160.70‑90 today.
EUR/USD

Strong Australian inflation and spending data have boosted expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) will raise rates again soon. At the same time, the three‑year government bond yield hit a one‑month high and the ten‑year yield rose to its highest level since May. The RBA also warned that rates could be raised further. Last Friday the Australian dollar climbed to a three‑month high, and markets see a 96% chance that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) will hike 25 basis points to 2.75% on Wednesday, lifting the kiwi and pushing the euro/dollar up to a 1.1657 peak.

Data show Germany’s July import prices rose 0.2% from the previous month and 6.8% year‑on‑year, above the prior figures. France reported August CPI and the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) up 2.7% and 2.4% year‑on‑year, respectively. An EU Commission survey in August showed the euro‑area’s economic, industrial and services confidence indices improving to 98.4, –5.3 and 5.8. However, Powell’s hawkish remarks lifted the dollar across the board, pulling the euro/dollar down to a 1.1577 low. The euro/dollar is expected to face resistance at 1.1590‑1.1610 and support at 1.1510‑1.1530 today.
GBP/USD

Last Friday, a Lloyds Bank survey showed UK August business confidence rising to 53, the highest since March, echoing other recent signs of improving economic outlook and supporting the pound at a 1.3598 high against the dollar. As Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said the second‑round inflation effect is relatively mild, and Powell’s hawkish comments boosted the dollar, the pound fell to a 1.3524 low. The pound/dollar is expected to encounter resistance at 1.3545‑1.3565 and support at 1.3450‑1.3480 today.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強本周漲約1% 華許演講提高9月升息預期
items.title_en: NY Forex: Dollar Strengthens, Up About 1% This Week; Warsh Speech Raises September Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(28日)升至近兩周高點， 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)會議發表首次主題演講後，市場認為其立場偏向鷹派。華許表示，美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，交易員因此提高對聯準會(Fed)9月升息的預期。
美元本周上漲約1%，收復前一周因美國公債大幅遭拋售、引發所謂「貨幣貶值交易」而蒙受的全部跌幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.5%，報99.65，為8月18日以來最高。
聯準會主席備受期待的傑克森霍爾年度經濟政策研討會演講，涵蓋從人工智慧(AI)、前瞻指引到當前經濟狀況等議題。值得注意的是，他表示美國潛在通膨趨勢並未「明顯改善」，並再次強調聯準會應將維持價格穩定作為政策重點。
華許演講之際，聯準會正處於複雜局面。近期通膨數據持續偏高，加上美國與伊朗似乎無休止的衝突推升油價，以及非農就業數據意外疲弱，導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部分歧加劇，3位地區聯準銀行總裁反對7月維持利率不變的決定。
華許在事先準備的講稿中表示，「截至目前，我認為勞動市場符合充分就業的狀態。但就我們的價格穩定職責而言，目前的數據更加令人擔憂。」
市場認為這場演講偏鷹，交易員提高對9月升息25個基點的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，9月升息25個基點的機率目前超過57%，高於前一天約35%。
德銀分析師Matthew Luzzetti率領團隊表示，「華許主席的演講，在對經濟與展望的具體程度，以及明顯偏鷹的立場方面，都令我們感到意外。在他的談話之後，我們認為，除非即將公布的數據大幅低於預期，否則9月升息25個基點的壓力已經落在數據上。反過來，我們仍認為聯準會今年將升息50個基點，分別在9月與12月會議升息。」
貨幣貶值交易退潮 美元回升
華許發表演講後，美國公債殖利率轉為上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期公債殖利率上升5.9個基點至4.729%，對利率較敏感的2年期公債殖利率則上升12個基點至4.352%。
近期債券市場劇烈震盪，長天期公債受到通膨疑慮、企業發債規模龐大，以及美國國債持續膨脹等因素影響而遭拋售。
美國財政部上周出人意料的干預措施，對抑制殖利率上升的效果有限。
一般來說，公債殖利率上升會產生類似升息的效果，因這會推高消費者與企業的借貸成本，通常有利於美元走強。但美國國債突破40兆美元的消息在上周引發市場對財政狀況的疑慮，在此環境下，投資人傾向將資金從法定貨幣轉向黃金或加密貨幣等硬資產，這種策略被稱為「貨幣貶值交易」。
事實上，美元指數上周下跌近1%，而黃金與加密貨幣則上漲。兩者本周也持續上漲，但在美元走強情況下，漲幅明顯較小。
加幣受貿易戰拖累 本周大幅下跌
其他主要貨幣方面，本周加幣受到外匯交易員關注，在華盛頓與渥太華之間的貿易戰升溫之際，加幣下跌1%。
美加兩國上周末談判破裂後，雙方相繼對彼此加徵報復性關稅。美國總統川普周四推動將安大略湖(Lake Ontario)更名為「美國湖」(Lake America)。
加拿大政府周五公布數據顯示，該國經濟第二季強勁反彈，按年率計成長3.3%，明顯高於第一季經上修後的0.3%增幅。這項成長符合經濟學家預期，但遠高於加拿大央行約2.5%的預測。
日元自歷史性干預後首度觸及160
華許發表鷹派演講後，日元周五承受壓力。美元兌日元觸及160，為美日兩國7月底進行歷史性聯合干預以來首次觸及這項水準。160也曾是過去引發干預的關鍵價位。
另一方面，韓元連續第二個交易日兌美元走強，美元兌韓元匯率本周下跌約0.5%。投資人消化韓國央行(BoK)周四連續第二次會議升息的決定後，韓元走強，借貸成本也因此升至18個月高點。
